### Load key input files

```{r LoadData, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
metadata <- read.table(metadata_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
mutations <- read.table(mutations_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
discarded_variants <- read.table(discarded_variants_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T, tryLogical = F)
coverage <- read.table(coverage_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
emseq <- read.table(emseq_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
immune_genes <- read.table(targeted_panel_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
B_mem_int_syn_burden <- read.table(B_mem_int_syn_burden_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
```

### Rescue genuine mutations that were discarded for exceeding VAF > 0.1 threshold during calling
Only one mutation rescued: DNMT3A mutation in PD66718.
This is the sole coding non-synonymous SNV in discarded variants with VAF > 0.1 and < 0.4 that is not in the HLA region.

```{r MergeDiscarded, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mutations <- rbind(mutations,discarded_variants)
```

### Annotate combined muts with donor, cell fraction and mutation site columns

```{r CellFractionAnnotation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mutations$donor <- substr(mutations$paper_id,1,2)

mutations$mut_site <- paste(substr(mutations$sampleID,1,7),mutations$chr,mutations$pos,mutations$ref,mutations$mut,sep = "_")

males <- metadata$sample[which(metadata$sex == "Male")]
mutations$cellfraction = mutations$duplex_vaf * 2
mutations$cellfraction[mutations$chr %in% c("X","Y") & mutations$sampleID %in% males] = mutations$duplex_vaf[mutations$chr %in% c("X","Y") & mutations$sampleID %in% males]

mutations$bam_mut_adj = pmax(0,mutations$bam_mut-mutations$times_called)
mutations$bam_cov_adj = mutations$bam_cov-mutations$duplex_cov
mutations$bam_vaf_adj = mutations$bam_mut_adj / mutations$bam_cov_adj
mutations$bam_adj_cellfraction = mutations$bam_vaf_adj * 2
mutations$bam_adj_cellfraction[mutations$chr %in% c("X","Y") & mutations$sampleID %in% males] = mutations$bam_vaf_adj[mutations$chr %in% c("X","Y") & mutations$sampleID %in% males]
```

### Annotate start losses
Impact of mutations annotated by dNdScv. This does not annotate start losses separately from other missense mutations, so annotate those separately here.

```{r DefineStartLosses}
# Define start_losses
mutations$impact[substr(mutations$aachange,2,nchar(mutations$aachange)-1) == "1"] <- "Start_loss"
```

### Define cohorts

```{r DefineCohorts, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Pilot exome cohort
pilot_exome <- metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Pilot" & metadata$sequencing_type == "Exome"] 
pilot_targeted <- metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Pilot" & metadata$sequencing_type == "Targeted"] 
pilot_all <- metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Pilot"] 

extension_all <- metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Extension"] 
extension_hashimoto <- metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Extension" & metadata$pathology == "Hashimoto"] 
extension_graves <- metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Extension" & metadata$pathology == "Graves"] 

extension_bulk <- metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Extension" & metadata$sample_type == "Bulk"] 
extension_LCM <- metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Extension" &  metadata$sample_type == "LCM"]

emseq_normal_thyroid <- emseq$sampleID[substr(emseq$paper_id,1,1) == "N"]
emseq_normal_spleen <- emseq$sampleID[substr(emseq$paper_id,1,1) == "S"]
emseq_normal_lymph_node <- emseq$sampleID[substr(emseq$paper_id,1,2) == "LN"]
emseq_B_mem <- emseq$sampleID[substr(emseq$paper_id,1,1) == "B"]
emseq_CD4_mem <- emseq$sampleID[substr(emseq$paper_id,1,2) == "HT"]
emseq_CD8_mem <- emseq$sampleID[substr(emseq$paper_id,1,2) == "CT"]
```

## 2. Targeted enzymatic methylation sequencing (EM-Seq)

### Pilot cohort cell type composition
Using Targeted EM-Seq, we assessed the cellular composition of the tissue biopsies by comparing methylation patterns to a published reference atlas (PMID: 36599988).

```{r EMSeqPilotSummary, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Print EM-Seq cell proportions for pilot Hashimoto cohort (exclude normal thyroid and malignant samples)
emseq_pilot_summary <- summary(emseq[substr(emseq$sampleID,1,8) %in% substr(pilot_exome,1,8),!(colnames(emseq) %in% c("sampleID_emseq","sampleID","paper_id"))])
summary_row_names <- gsub(":.*","",emseq_pilot_summary[,1])
emseq_pilot_summary <- gsub(".*:","",emseq_pilot_summary)
emseq_pilot_summary <- gsub(" ","",emseq_pilot_summary)
emseq_pilot_summary <- apply(emseq_pilot_summary, 2, function(x) as.numeric(x))
row.names(emseq_pilot_summary) <- summary_row_names
kable(t(signif(emseq_pilot_summary)), digits =3, caption = "EM-Seq cell proportions for pilot Hashimoto cohort")
```

```{r EMSeqNormalThyroidSummary, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Print EM-Seq cell proportions for normal thyroid samples with no history of autoimmune thyroiditis
emseq_normal_summary <- summary(emseq[emseq$sampleID %in% emseq_normal_thyroid,!(colnames(emseq) %in% c("sampleID_emseq","sampleID","paper_id"))])
summary_row_names <- gsub(":.*","",emseq_normal_summary[,1])
emseq_normal_summary <- gsub(".*:","",emseq_normal_summary)
emseq_normal_summary <- gsub(" ","",emseq_normal_summary)
emseq_normal_summary <- apply(emseq_normal_summary, 2, function(x) as.numeric(x))
row.names(emseq_normal_summary) <- summary_row_names
kable(t(signif(emseq_normal_summary)), digits =3, caption = "EM-Seq cell proportions for normal thyroid")
```

### Cell type composition plot for pilot and normal thyroid samples
```{r Fig1B_CellTypeCompositionPilotNormal,message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=6}
methylation_colours <- setNames(c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal("Set3", n = ncol(emseq) - 3)),c("Blood_B","Blood_T","Blood_MonocyteMacrophage","Blood_NK","Blood_Granulocyte","ThyroidEpithelium","Endothelial","Fibroblast","Adipocytes","SmoothMuscle","Other"))

emseq_plot <- reshape2::melt(emseq, id.vars = c("sampleID_emseq","sampleID","paper_id"))

emseq_plot$cohort <- NA
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% emseq_normal_thyroid)] <- "normal"
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% substr(metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Pilot"],1,16))] <- "pilot"
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% substr(metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Extension" & metadata$pathology == "Hashimoto" & metadata$sample_type == "Bulk"],1,16))] <- "ex_hash_bulk"
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% substr(metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Extension" & metadata$pathology == "Graves" & metadata$sample_type == "Bulk"],1,16))] <- "ex_graves_bulk"
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% substr(metadata$sample[metadata$cohort == "Extension" & metadata$sample_type == "LCM"],1,16))] <- "ex_lcm"
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% emseq_normal_spleen)] <- "spleen"
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% emseq_normal_lymph_node)] <- "lymph_node"
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% emseq_B_mem)] <- "b_mem"
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% emseq_CD4_mem)] <- "cd4_mem"
emseq_plot$cohort[which(emseq_plot$sampleID %in% emseq_CD8_mem)] <- "cd8_mem"

# Order by B-cell fraction pilot cohort
emseq_plot_order <- emseq_plot[which(emseq_plot$variable == "Blood_B"),] %>% arrange(desc(value), .by_group = TRUE)
emseq_plot$sampleID <- factor(emseq_plot$sampleID, levels = emseq_plot_order$sampleID)
emseq_plot$variable <- factor(emseq_plot$variable, levels = names(methylation_colours))
emseq_plot$cohort <- factor(emseq_plot$cohort, levels = c("normal","pilot","ex_hash_bulk","ex_graves_bulk","ex_lcm","spleen","lymph_node","b_mem","cd4_mem","cd8_mem"))

if (runman) { dev.new(width=5, height=6) }
ggplot(data = emseq_plot[which(emseq_plot$cohort %in% c("normal","pilot") & !(emseq_plot$paper_id %in% c("H3b","H3c"))),], aes(x = sampleID, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = methylation_colours) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(emseq_plot$paper_id,emseq_plot$sampleID)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Cell fraction", fill = "Cell type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), plot.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 6)) +
  facet_grid(.~cohort, space = "free", scales = "free_x", labeller = as_labeller(c(normal = "Normal thyroid", pilot = "Pilot", ex_hash_bulk = "Extension Hashimoto (bulk)", ex_graves_bulk = "Extension Graves (bulk)", ex_lcm = "Extension (LCM)"))) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12), strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank())
if (runman) { dev.copy(pdf,"./emseq_barplot_normal_pilot.pdf",width=5,height=6); dev.off() }
```

## 4. dNdSshm for exome pilot cohort

```{r dNdSshmExomePilotCohort, results = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sample_list <- pilot_exome

dnds_muts <- mutations[which(mutations$sampleID %in% sample_list),]
dnds_muts <- dnds_muts[which(!(duplicated(dnds_muts$mut_site))),]

dnds_cov <- rowSums(coverage[which(colnames(coverage) %in% sample_list)])
names(dnds_cov) <- coverage$gene
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(dnds_cov != 0)]

# 2024-02-19 - Made decision to exclude IGLL5 and IGLL1 from dNdS analysis. Only reason these Ig genes (but not others) are in the dNdS object is they are in frame.
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(!(names(dnds_cov) %in% c("IGLL5","IGLL1")))]

pilot_exome_dnds_shm <- dnds_shm(mutations = dnds_muts[,c("sampleID","chr","pos","ref","mut")],
                                 refdb_noshm = RefCDS_noshm_exome,
                                 refdb_shm = RefCDS_shm_exome,
                                 dc_noshm = dnds_cov,
                                 gene_list = names(dnds_cov),
                                 # Exons with just the start codon need to be excluded (synonymous mutations are not possible for dNdSloc)
                                 excl_shm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5","MYO1E","ZNF595","AC026202.1","EHBP1L1"),
                                 excl_noshm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5"),
                                 onesided = T,
                                 maxcovs = 10)
```

```{r, DriverListPilotExome}
# Significant genes in pilot exome data
pilot_exome_drivers <- pilot_exome_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name[pilot_exome_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qglobalpos_m < 0.01]

# Total number of non-synonymous mutations across driver genes in pilot exome data
pilot_driver_muts <- mutations[mutations$gene %in% pilot_exome_drivers & mutations$sampleID %in% pilot_exome,]
pilot_driver_muts_unique <- pilot_driver_muts[!(duplicated(pilot_driver_muts$mut_site)),]

pilot_driver_counts <- sort(colSums(table(substr(pilot_driver_muts_unique$paper_id[pilot_driver_muts_unique$impact != "Synonymous"],1,2), pilot_driver_muts_unique$gene[pilot_driver_muts_unique$impact != "Synonymous"])), decreasing = T)

# Sort driver list by decreasing number of mutations
pilot_exome_drivers <- names(pilot_driver_counts)

kable(as.data.frame(pilot_driver_counts), caption = "Non-synonymous driver gene mutations (unique per donor) in pilot exome data", col.names = c("Gene","Mutation count"))
```

```{r, ExomeDriverListConfidenceIntervalCalculation, results = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pilot_exome_no_shm_snv_ci <- dndscv::geneci(dndsout = pilot_exome_dnds_shm, gene_list = pilot_exome_drivers)
pilot_exome_no_shm_indel_ci <- geneindelci(geneindels = pilot_exome_dnds_shm$geneindels, gene_list = pilot_exome_drivers, theta = pilot_exome_dnds_shm$nbregind$theta)

pilot_exome_no_shm_gene_ci <- cbind(pilot_exome_no_shm_snv_ci,pilot_exome_no_shm_indel_ci[,c(2:ncol(pilot_exome_no_shm_indel_ci))])

pilot_exome_shm_gene_ci <- geneciloc(pilot_exome_dnds_shm$genemuts_shm)
```

```{r Additional_PerDonorExomeOnlyCombinedDriverPlot, fig.height=15, fig.width=20}
if (runman) { dev.new() }

samples2plot <- pilot_exome
genes2plot <- pilot_exome_drivers

muts2plot <- mutations[which(mutations$gene %in% genes2plot & mutations$sampleID %in% samples2plot),]
uniq2plot <- muts2plot[which(!(duplicated(muts2plot$mut_site))),]
donors2plot <- unique(substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2))

plot_rows <- 3
plot_cols <- length(genes2plot)

layout(matrix(c(1:(plot_rows*plot_cols)), nrow = plot_rows, ncol = plot_cols, byrow = F), widths = rep(4,times = length(genes2plot)))
par(mar = c(5,5.5,2,2))

nmut_array <- table(substr(uniq2plot$paper_id,1,2),
                    uniq2plot$impact,
                    uniq2plot$gene)

genes2plot = names(sort(apply(nmut_array, MARGIN = c(3), sum),decreasing=T)) # Sorting the genes in decreasing order of their number of mutations

nmuts_cap <- ceiling(max(apply(nmut_array, MARGIN = c(1,3), sum)) / 10) * 10

# Calculate cell fractions
cellfraction = array(NA, dim = c(length(donors2plot),8,length(genes2plot)), dimnames = list(donors2plot, c("mis","non","spl","ind","mislow","nonlow","spllow","indlow"),genes2plot))

for(x in 1:length(genes2plot)) {  
  for (j in 1:length(donors2plot)) {
    aux = muts2plot[which(muts2plot$gene==genes2plot[x] & substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2) == donors2plot[j]),c("sampleID","paper_id","impact","cellfraction","duplex_vaf")]
    per_sample_gene_cov <- coverage[which(coverage$gene == genes2plot[x]),colnames(coverage) %in% samples2plot[samples2plot %in% muts2plot$sampleID[substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2) == donors2plot[j]]]]
    aux$sample_gene_cov <- NA
    aux$cov_weighting <- NA
    for(k in 1:length(per_sample_gene_cov)){
      aux$sample_gene_cov[which(aux$sampleID == names(per_sample_gene_cov)[k])] <- as.numeric(per_sample_gene_cov[k])
    }
    aux$cov_weighting <- aux$sample_gene_cov / sum(per_sample_gene_cov)
    
    aux$weighted_cellfraction <- aux$cellfraction * aux$cov_weighting
    aux$weighted_duplex_vaf <- aux$duplex_vaf * aux$cov_weighting
    
    cellfraction[j,c("mis","mislow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact %in% c("Missense","Start_loss","Stop_loss"),c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
    cellfraction[j,c("non","nonlow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="Nonsense",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
    cellfraction[j,c("spl","spllow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="Essential_Splice",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
    cellfraction[j,c("ind","indlow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="no-SNV",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
  }
}

# Object to output median adjusted bam VAF per gene across donors
median_bam_vaf_adj <- vector(mode = "numeric",length = length(genes2plot))
names(median_bam_vaf_adj) <- genes2plot
max_bam_vaf_adj <- median_bam_vaf_adj
below_1_bam_vaf_adj <- median_bam_vaf_adj

# Create three plots per donor: number of mutations, per mutation (mean across samples) unbiased VAF and mutant cell fraction
for(x in 1:length(genes2plot)){
  nmuts <- nmut_array[,,genes2plot[x]]
  subs_per_donor = t(nmuts)
  subs_per_donor = subs_per_donor[c("Synonymous","Missense","Start_loss","Stop_loss","Nonsense","Essential_Splice","no-SNV"),]
  rownames(subs_per_donor)[rownames(subs_per_donor) == "Essential_Splice"] <- "Splice"
  rownames(subs_per_donor)[rownames(subs_per_donor) == "no-SNV"] <- "Indels"
  
  colvec = c("Synonymous"="grey70","Missense"="cadetblue","Start_loss"="firebrick","Stop_loss"="red","Nonsense"="darkorchid4","Splice"="darkorchid2","Indels"="chocolate3")
  
  pos = barplot(subs_per_donor, las = 1, col=colvec, border=NA, ylim=c(0,nmuts_cap), ylab="Mutations per donor", main = genes2plot[x])
  
  if(x == 1){
    legend("topright",y=max(apply(subs_per_donor,2,sum))*1.09,legend=rownames(subs_per_donor),fill=colvec,border=NA,box.col=NA,bg="transparent")
  }
  
  # Calculate the mean unbiased VAF for mutations detected in multiple sequencing libraries from a donor
  # This avoids representing the same mutation multiple times in the scatter plot
  uniq2plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj <- NA
  for(y in 1:nrow(uniq2plot)){
    uniq2plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[y] <- mean(pilot_driver_muts$bam_vaf_adj[pilot_driver_muts$mut_site == uniq2plot$mut_site[y]])
  }
  
  uniq2plot_cap <- 1.1*max(uniq2plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj)
  
  df_plot <- uniq2plot[uniq2plot$gene == genes2plot[x],]
  df_plot <- df_plot[order(df_plot$paper_id,decreasing = F),]
  df_plot$idx <- jitter(pos[as.numeric(substr(df_plot$paper_id,2,2))])
  df_plot$impact[df_plot$impact == "Essential_Splice"] <- "Splice"
  df_plot$impact[df_plot$impact == "no-SNV"] <- "Indels"
  df_plot$colour <- colvec[df_plot$impact]
  
  plot(df_plot$idx,df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj,col=df_plot$colour,xlab=NA, 
       xlim=c(0.2,3.6), ylim=c(0,uniq2plot_cap),ylab = "Unbiased VAF", bg="transparent", pch = 19, cex = 2, frame.plot = FALSE, axes = F)
  axis(side = 2, las = 1)
  axis(side = 1, at=pos, labels=unique(substr(df_plot$paper_id,1,2)), tick = F, pos = NA)
  
  for(y in 1:length(pos)){
    segments(x0 = pos[y] - 0.5, x1 = pos[y] + 0.5, 
             y0=median(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[which(substr(df_plot$paper_id,2,2) == y)]), 
             y1 = median(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[which(substr(df_plot$paper_id,2,2) == y)]), 
             lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
  }
  
  median_bam_vaf_adj[x] <- median(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[df_plot$impact != "Synonymous"])
  max_bam_vaf_adj[x] <- max(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[df_plot$impact != "Synonymous"])
  below_1_bam_vaf_adj[x] <- 100 * length(which(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[df_plot$impact != "Synonymous"] < 0.01)) / length(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[df_plot$impact != "Synonymous"])
  
  nonsyndens_cap <- ceiling(max(apply(cellfraction[,1:4,] * 100,3,rowSums)) / 10) * 10
  
  nonsyndens = cellfraction[,,x] * 100
  nonsyndens_bounds = cbind(up = rowSums(nonsyndens[,1:4]), low=rowSums(nonsyndens[,5:8]))
  aux = t(cbind(nonsyndens_bounds[,2],nonsyndens_bounds[,1]-nonsyndens_bounds[,2]))
  
  # This allows a bar to be visible when MCF is zero.
  aux[which(aux == 0)] <- 0.001
  
  pos = barplot(aux[2,], col=c("indianred3"), border=c("indianred3"), ylab="% cells non-synonymous mutation", ylim=c(0,nonsyndens_cap), offset = aux[1,], las = 1)
}
```

```{r Fig1D_PerDonorExomeTargetedCombinedDriverPlot, fig.height=15, fig.width=20}
if (runman) { dev.new() }

samples2plot <- pilot_all
genes2plot <- pilot_exome_drivers

muts2plot <- mutations[which(mutations$gene %in% genes2plot & mutations$sampleID %in% samples2plot),]
uniq2plot <- muts2plot[which(!(duplicated(muts2plot$mut_site))),]
donors2plot <- unique(substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2))

plot_rows <- 3
plot_cols <- length(genes2plot)

layout(matrix(c(1:(plot_rows*plot_cols)), nrow = plot_rows, ncol = plot_cols, byrow = F), widths = rep(4,times = length(genes2plot)))
par(mar = c(5,5.5,2,2))

nmut_array <- table(substr(uniq2plot$paper_id,1,2),
                    uniq2plot$impact,
                    uniq2plot$gene)

genes2plot = names(sort(apply(nmut_array, MARGIN = c(3), sum),decreasing=T)) # Sorting the genes in decreasing order of their number of mutations

nmuts_cap <- ceiling(max(apply(nmut_array, MARGIN = c(1,3), sum)) / 10) * 10

# Calculate cell fractions
cellfraction = array(NA, dim = c(length(donors2plot),8,length(genes2plot)), dimnames = list(donors2plot, c("mis","non","spl","ind","mislow","nonlow","spllow","indlow"),genes2plot))

for(x in 1:length(genes2plot)) {  
  for (j in 1:length(donors2plot)) {
    aux = muts2plot[which(muts2plot$gene==genes2plot[x] & substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2) == donors2plot[j]),c("sampleID","paper_id","impact","cellfraction","duplex_vaf")]
    per_sample_gene_cov <- coverage[which(coverage$gene == genes2plot[x]),colnames(coverage) %in% samples2plot[samples2plot %in% muts2plot$sampleID[substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2) == donors2plot[j]]]]
    aux$sample_gene_cov <- NA
    aux$cov_weighting <- NA
    for(k in 1:length(per_sample_gene_cov)){
      aux$sample_gene_cov[which(aux$sampleID == names(per_sample_gene_cov)[k])] <- as.numeric(per_sample_gene_cov[k])
    }
    aux$cov_weighting <- aux$sample_gene_cov / sum(per_sample_gene_cov)
    
    aux$weighted_cellfraction <- aux$cellfraction * aux$cov_weighting
    aux$weighted_duplex_vaf <- aux$duplex_vaf * aux$cov_weighting
    
    cellfraction[j,c("mis","mislow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact %in% c("Missense","Start_loss","Stop_loss"),c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
    cellfraction[j,c("non","nonlow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="Nonsense",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
    cellfraction[j,c("spl","spllow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="Essential_Splice",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
    cellfraction[j,c("ind","indlow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="no-SNV",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
  }
}

# Object to output median adjusted bam VAF per gene across donors
median_bam_vaf_adj <- vector(mode = "numeric",length = length(genes2plot))
names(median_bam_vaf_adj) <- genes2plot
max_bam_vaf_adj <- median_bam_vaf_adj
below_1_bam_vaf_adj <- median_bam_vaf_adj

# Create three plots per donor: number of mutations, per mutation (mean across samples) unbiased VAF and mutant cell fraction
for(x in 1:length(genes2plot)){
  nmuts <- nmut_array[,,genes2plot[x]]
  subs_per_donor = t(nmuts)
  subs_per_donor = subs_per_donor[c("Synonymous","Missense","Start_loss","Stop_loss","Nonsense","Essential_Splice","no-SNV"),]
  rownames(subs_per_donor)[rownames(subs_per_donor) == "Essential_Splice"] <- "Splice"
  rownames(subs_per_donor)[rownames(subs_per_donor) == "no-SNV"] <- "Indels"
  
  colvec = c("Synonymous"="grey70","Missense"="cadetblue","Start_loss"="firebrick","Stop_loss"="red","Nonsense"="darkorchid4","Splice"="darkorchid2","Indels"="chocolate3")
  
  pos = barplot(subs_per_donor, las = 1, col=colvec, border=NA, ylim=c(0,nmuts_cap), ylab="Mutations per donor", main = genes2plot[x])
  
  if(x == 1){
    legend("topright",y=max(apply(subs_per_donor,2,sum))*1.09,legend=rownames(subs_per_donor),fill=colvec,border=NA,box.col=NA,bg="transparent")
  }
  
  # Calculate the mean unbiased VAF for mutations detected in multiple sequencing libraries from a donor
  # This avoids representing the same mutation multiple times in the scatter plot
  uniq2plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj <- NA
  for(y in 1:nrow(uniq2plot)){
    uniq2plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[y] <- mean(pilot_all_exome_driver_muts$bam_vaf_adj[pilot_all_exome_driver_muts$mut_site == uniq2plot$mut_site[y]])
  }
  
  uniq2plot_cap <- 1.1*max(uniq2plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj)
  
  df_plot <- uniq2plot[uniq2plot$gene == genes2plot[x],]
  df_plot <- df_plot[order(df_plot$paper_id,decreasing = F),]
  df_plot$idx <- jitter(pos[as.numeric(substr(df_plot$paper_id,2,2))])
  df_plot$impact[df_plot$impact == "Essential_Splice"] <- "Splice"
  df_plot$impact[df_plot$impact == "no-SNV"] <- "Indels"
  df_plot$colour <- colvec[df_plot$impact]
  
  plot(df_plot$idx,df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj,col=df_plot$colour,xlab=NA, 
       xlim=c(0.2,3.6), ylim=c(0,uniq2plot_cap),ylab = "Unbiased VAF", bg="transparent", pch = 19, cex = 2, frame.plot = FALSE, axes = F)
  axis(side = 2, las = 1)
  axis(side = 1, at=pos, labels=unique(substr(df_plot$paper_id,1,2)), tick = F, pos = NA)
  
  for(y in 1:length(pos)){
    segments(x0 = pos[y] - 0.5, x1 = pos[y] + 0.5, 
             y0=median(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[which(substr(df_plot$paper_id,2,2) == y)]), 
             y1 = median(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[which(substr(df_plot$paper_id,2,2) == y)]), 
             lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
  }
  
  median_bam_vaf_adj[x] <- median(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[df_plot$impact != "Synonymous"])
  max_bam_vaf_adj[x] <- max(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[df_plot$impact != "Synonymous"])
  below_1_bam_vaf_adj[x] <- 100 * length(which(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[df_plot$impact != "Synonymous"] < 0.01)) / length(df_plot$mean_bam_vaf_adj[df_plot$impact != "Synonymous"])
  
  nonsyndens_cap <- ceiling(max(apply(cellfraction[,1:4,] * 100,3,rowSums)) / 10) * 10
  
  nonsyndens = cellfraction[,,x] * 100
  nonsyndens_bounds = cbind(up = rowSums(nonsyndens[,1:4]), low=rowSums(nonsyndens[,5:8]))
  aux = t(cbind(nonsyndens_bounds[,2],nonsyndens_bounds[,1]-nonsyndens_bounds[,2]))
  
  # This allows a bar to be visible when MCF is zero.
  aux[which(aux == 0)] <- 0.001
  
  pos = barplot(aux[2,], col=c("indianred3"), border=c("indianred3"), ylab="% cells non-synonymous mutation", ylim=c(0,nonsyndens_cap), offset = aux[1,], las = 1)
}
```

## 8. dNdSshm for combined exome and targeted data in pilot and extension cohorts

```{r dNdSshmExomeOnlyPilotAndExtensionCohortsCombined, results = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# dNdS results for exome data only from pilot and extension cohorts - used for annotating exome only dN/dS q-values in Fig. 2
sample_list <- metadata$sample[metadata$sequencing_type == "Exome"]

dnds_muts <- mutations[which(mutations$sampleID %in% sample_list),]
dnds_muts <- dnds_muts[which(!(duplicated(dnds_muts$mut_site))),]

dnds_cov <- rowSums(coverage[which(colnames(coverage) %in% sample_list)])
names(dnds_cov) <- coverage$gene
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(dnds_cov != 0)]

# 2024-02-19 - Made decision to exclude IGLL5 and IGLL1 from dNdS analysis. Only reason these Ig genes (but not others) are in the dNdS object is they are in frame.
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(!(names(dnds_cov) %in% c("IGLL5","IGLL1")))]

exome_only_dnds_shm <- dnds_shm(mutations = dnds_muts[,c("sampleID","chr","pos","ref","mut")],
                                refdb_noshm = RefCDS_noshm_exome,
                                refdb_shm = RefCDS_shm_exome,
                                dc_noshm = dnds_cov,
                                gene_list = names(dnds_cov),
                                # Exons with just the start codon need to be excluded (synonymous mutations are not possible for dNdSloc)
                                excl_shm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5","MYO1E","ZNF595","AC026202.1","EHBP1L1"),
                                excl_noshm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5"),
                                onesided = T,
                                maxcovs = 10)
```

```{r dNdSshmTargetedOnlyPilotAndExtensionCohortsCombined, results = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
                                   excl_noshm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5"),

                                   maxcovs = 10)
```



```{r, DriverMutationCountsAllSamplesUniquePerDonor}
# Significant genes in combined targeted and exome data across index and extension cohorts
all_shm_merged <- all_dnds_shm$sel_merged

# Total number of non-synonymous mutations across driver genes
all_driver_muts <- mutations[mutations$gene %in% all_drivers,]
all_driver_muts_unique <- all_driver_muts[!(duplicated(all_driver_muts$mut_site)),]

all_driver_counts <- sort(colSums(table(substr(all_driver_muts_unique$paper_id[all_driver_muts_unique$impact != "Synonymous"],1,2), all_driver_muts_unique$gene[all_driver_muts_unique$impact != "Synonymous"])), decreasing = T)

kable(all_driver_counts, col.names = c("Gene","Mutation count"), caption = "Total non-synonymous mutations (unique per donor) across driver genes in combined pilot and extension cohorts")
```

### Driver discovery from extension cohort only
```{r, dNdSshmExtensionCohortOnly, results = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# dNdS results for combined exome and targeted data fron extension cohort only (restricted to genes in targeted panel)
sample_list <- extension_all

dnds_muts <- mutations[which(mutations$sampleID %in% sample_list),]
dnds_muts <- dnds_muts[which(!(duplicated(dnds_muts$mut_site))),]

dnds_cov <- rowSums(coverage[which(colnames(coverage) %in% sample_list)])
names(dnds_cov) <- coverage$gene
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(dnds_cov != 0)]

# 2024-02-19 - Made decision to exclude IGLL5 and IGLL1 from dNdS analysis. Only reason these Ig genes (but not others) are in the dNdS object is they are in frame.
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(!(names(dnds_cov) %in% c("IGLL5","IGLL1")))]

# Restrict dN/dS analysis to genes in targeted panel
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(names(dnds_cov) %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")])]

extension_only_dnds_shm <- dnds_shm(mutations = dnds_muts[,c("sampleID","chr","pos","ref","mut")],
                                    refdb_noshm = RefCDS_noshm_exome,
                                    refdb_shm = RefCDS_shm_exome,
                                    dc_noshm = dnds_cov,
                                    gene_list = names(dnds_cov),
                                    # Exons with just the start codon need to be excluded (synonymous mutations are not possible for dNdSloc)
                                    excl_shm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5","MYO1E","ZNF595","AC026202.1","EHBP1L1"),
                                    excl_noshm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5"),
                                    onesided = T,
                                    maxcovs = 10)
```

## 9. Variability in mutation frequency between donors (bulk samples)
### Interdonor variability heatmap (excluding LCM samples)
```{r, Fig2D_InterdonorVariabilityBulkSamplesHeatmap}
# Define driver genes to plot
genes2plot <- c(all_drivers,"RLTPR")

# Remove LCM samples from mutant cell fraction calculation and from number of mutations as these will skew the mutant cell fraction of driver genes enriched in lymphocytes (we will plot a separate heatmap for LCM samples)
samples2plot <- metadata$sample[!(metadata$sample_type == "LCM")]

# Define mutation inputs
# All mutations in a sample for strip below heatmap
allmuts2plot <- mutations[which(mutations$sampleID %in% samples2plot),]
alluniq2plot <- allmuts2plot[which(!(duplicated(allmuts2plot$mut_site))),]

# Limit mutations to those non-synonymous mutations in driver genes
muts2plot <- mutations[which(mutations$gene %in% genes2plot & mutations$sampleID %in% samples2plot & mutations$impact != "Synonymous"),]
# Remove mutations with NA duplex VAF (only affects three indels in HLA-A) from heatmap
muts2plot <- muts2plot[!(is.na(muts2plot$duplex_vaf)),]
uniq2plot <- muts2plot[which(!(duplicated(muts2plot$mut_site))),]
donors2plot <- unique(substr(metadata$paper_id,1,2))
donor_mut_count <- table(uniq2plot$gene, substr(uniq2plot$paper_id,1,2))

# Define age and sex of donors (age will be used for ordering of donors, sex will be used for mutant cell fraction calculation)
age <- setNames(metadata$age, substr(metadata$paper_id,1,2))[colnames(donor_mut_count)]
age <- age[order(age, decreasing = F)]
sex <- substr(setNames(metadata$sex, substr(metadata$paper_id,1,2)),1,1)[colnames(donor_mut_count)]
donor_mut_count <- donor_mut_count[match(all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name[all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name %in% rownames(donor_mut_count)], rownames(donor_mut_count)),]

# Order samples by lymphocyte fraction
emseq_bulk <- emseq[emseq$sampleID %in% gsub("_exome","",gsub("_targeted","",metadata$sample[metadata$sample_type == "Bulk"])),c("paper_id","Blood_B", "Blood_T","Blood_NK")]
emseq_bulk <- emseq_bulk[!(emseq_bulk$paper_id %in% c("H3b","H3c")),]
emseq_bulk$paper_id <- substr(emseq_bulk$paper_id,1,2)
emseq_bulk$Blood_lymph <- emseq_bulk$Blood_B+emseq_bulk$Blood_T+emseq_bulk$Blood_NK
# emseq_bulk <- emseq_bulk[,-which(colnames(emseq_bulk) %in% c("Blood_B", "Blood_T"))]
emseq_bulk_agg <- aggregate(list(Blood_lymph=emseq_bulk$Blood_lymph), by=list(paper_id=emseq_bulk$paper_id), FUN="mean") 
emseq_bulk_agg <- emseq_bulk_agg[order(emseq_bulk_agg$Blood_lymph, decreasing = T),]
emseq_bulk_B <- aggregate(list(Blood_B=emseq_bulk$Blood_B), by=list(paper_id=emseq_bulk$paper_id), FUN="mean") 
emseq_bulk_T <- aggregate(list(Blood_T=emseq_bulk$Blood_T), by=list(paper_id=emseq_bulk$paper_id), FUN="mean") 

# Calculate polyclonal mutant cell fraction
cellfraction = array(NA, dim = c(length(donors2plot),8,length(genes2plot)), dimnames = list(donors2plot, c("mis","non","spl","ind","mislow","nonlow","spllow","indlow"),genes2plot))

nonsyn_lbd <- as.data.frame(array(data = NA, dim = c(length(donors2plot)*length(genes2plot),3)))
colnames(nonsyn_lbd) <- c("donor","gene","cellfraction")

for(x in 1:length(genes2plot)) {  
  for (j in 1:length(donors2plot)) {
    aux = muts2plot[which(muts2plot$gene==genes2plot[x] & substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2) == donors2plot[j]),c("sampleID","paper_id","impact","cellfraction","duplex_vaf")]
    per_sample_gene_cov <- coverage[which(coverage$gene == genes2plot[x]),colnames(coverage) %in% samples2plot[samples2plot %in% muts2plot$sampleID[substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2) == donors2plot[j]]], drop = F]
    if(nrow(aux) > 0){
      aux$sample_gene_cov <- NA
      aux$cov_weighting <- NA
      for(k in 1:length(per_sample_gene_cov)){
        aux$sample_gene_cov[which(aux$sampleID == names(per_sample_gene_cov)[k])] <- as.numeric(per_sample_gene_cov[k])
      }
      aux$cov_weighting <- aux$sample_gene_cov / sum(per_sample_gene_cov)
      
      aux$weighted_cellfraction <- aux$cellfraction * aux$cov_weighting
      aux$weighted_duplex_vaf <- aux$duplex_vaf * aux$cov_weighting
      
      cellfraction[j,c("mis","mislow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact %in% c("Missense","Start_loss","Stop_loss"),c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
      cellfraction[j,c("non","nonlow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="Nonsense",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
      cellfraction[j,c("spl","spllow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="Essential_Splice",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
      cellfraction[j,c("ind","indlow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="no-SNV",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
    }else{
      cellfraction[j,1:8,x] = 0
    }
    nonsyn_lbd$donor[(x-1)*length(donors2plot)+j] <- donors2plot[j]
    nonsyn_lbd$gene[(x-1)*length(donors2plot)+j] <- genes2plot[x]
    nonsyn_lbd$cellfraction[(x-1)*length(donors2plot)+j] <- sum(cellfraction[j,c(5:8),x])
  }
}

# Transpose and reorganise data for plotting
grid = expand.grid(x = rownames(donor_mut_count), y = colnames(donor_mut_count))
grid$z = c(donor_mut_count)
grid_merge <- merge(x=grid,y=nonsyn_lbd, by.x=c("y","x"), by.y=c("donor","gene"))
names(grid_merge)[names(grid_merge) == "cellfraction"] <- "a"
grid_merge$y <- factor(x = grid_merge$y, levels = emseq_bulk_agg$paper_id)
grid_merge$x <- factor(x = grid_merge$x, levels = rev(genes2plot))
grid_merge$a <- as.numeric(grid_merge$a)*100

# Cap the mutant cell fraction at 10% to highlight those in the 1-10% range
grid_merge[which(grid_merge$a > 10),]$a <- 10

# Define colour scheme
color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkorange", "plum3"))

lattice.options(axis.padding=list(factor=0.5)) #remove white border around lattice heatmap
bulk_heatmap <- lattice::levelplot(a~y*x, data = grid_merge, col.regions=color.palette(11001)[c(1,1001:11001)], scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1.5), x = list(cex = 1.5, alternating = 3, rot=0)), ylab=" ", xlab = "", colorkey=list(space="top", labels=list(cex=1.5)), at = seq(from = 0, to = 10, by = 0.001), main = list(label = "Aggregate mutant cell fraction (lower bound %)", cex = 2, side=1, line=0.5, hjust=0.3)) +
  latticeExtra::as.layer(
    lattice::levelplot(z~y*x, grid_merge, col.regions=NA, scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1.5), x = list(cex=1.5,rot=0)), colorkey=list(space="bottom"),
                       panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
```

## 10. Variability in mutation frequency between donors (LCM samples only)
### Interdonor variability heatmap (LCM samples only)
```{r, EDF1C_InterdonorVariabilityLCMSamplesHeatmap}
# Define driver genes to plot
genes2plot <- c(all_drivers,"RLTPR")

# Remove LCM samples from mutant cell fraction calculation and from number of mutations as these will skew the mutant cell fraction of driver genes enriched in lymphocytes (we will plot a separate heatmap for LCM samples)
samples2plot <- metadata$sample[(metadata$sample_type == "LCM")]

# Define mutation inputs
# All mutations in a sample for strip below heatmap
allmuts2plot <- mutations[which(mutations$sampleID %in% samples2plot),]
alluniq2plot <- allmuts2plot[which(!(duplicated(allmuts2plot$mut_site))),]

# Limit mutations to those non-synonymous mutations in driver genes
muts2plot <- mutations[which(mutations$gene %in% genes2plot & mutations$sampleID %in% samples2plot & mutations$impact != "Synonymous"),]
# Remove mutations with NA duplex VAF (only affects three indels in HLA-A) from heatmap
muts2plot <- muts2plot[!(is.na(muts2plot$duplex_vaf)),]
uniq2plot <- muts2plot[which(!(duplicated(muts2plot$mut_site))),]
donors2plot <- unique(substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2))
donor_mut_count <- table(uniq2plot$gene, substr(uniq2plot$paper_id,1,2))

# Define age and sex of donors (age will be used for ordering of donors, sex will be used for mutant cell fraction calculation)
age <- setNames(metadata$age, substr(metadata$paper_id,1,2))[colnames(donor_mut_count)]
age <- age[order(age, decreasing = F)]
sex <- substr(setNames(metadata$sex, substr(metadata$paper_id,1,2)),1,1)[colnames(donor_mut_count)]
donor_mut_count <- donor_mut_count[match(all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name[all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name %in% rownames(donor_mut_count)], rownames(donor_mut_count)),]

# Order samples by B-cell fraction
emseq_LCM <- emseq[emseq$sampleID %in% gsub("_exome","",gsub("_targeted","",metadata$sample[metadata$sample_type == "LCM"])),c("paper_id","Blood_B", "Blood_T","Blood_NK")]
emseq_LCM <- emseq_LCM[!(emseq_LCM$paper_id %in% c("H3b","H3c")),]
emseq_LCM$paper_id <- substr(emseq_LCM$paper_id,1,2)
emseq_LCM$Blood_lymph <- emseq_LCM$Blood_B+emseq_LCM$Blood_T+emseq_LCM$Blood_NK
emseq_LCM_agg <- aggregate(list(Blood_lymph=emseq_LCM$Blood_lymph), by=list(paper_id=emseq_LCM$paper_id), FUN="mean") 
emseq_LCM_agg <- emseq_LCM_agg[order(emseq_LCM_agg$Blood_lymph, decreasing = T),]
emseq_LCM_B <- aggregate(list(Blood_B=emseq_LCM$Blood_B), by=list(paper_id=emseq_LCM$paper_id), FUN="mean") 
emseq_LCM_T <- aggregate(list(Blood_T=emseq_LCM$Blood_T), by=list(paper_id=emseq_LCM$paper_id), FUN="mean") 

# Calculate polyclonal mutant cell fraction
cellfraction = array(NA, dim = c(length(donors2plot),8,length(genes2plot)), dimnames = list(donors2plot, c("mis","non","spl","ind","mislow","nonlow","spllow","indlow"),genes2plot))

nonsyn_lbd <- as.data.frame(array(data = NA, dim = c(length(donors2plot)*length(genes2plot),3)))
colnames(nonsyn_lbd) <- c("donor","gene","cellfraction")

for(x in 1:length(genes2plot)) {  
  for (j in 1:length(donors2plot)) {
    aux = muts2plot[which(muts2plot$gene==genes2plot[x] & substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2) == donors2plot[j]),c("sampleID","paper_id","impact","cellfraction","duplex_vaf")]
    per_sample_gene_cov <- coverage[which(coverage$gene == genes2plot[x]),colnames(coverage) %in% samples2plot[samples2plot %in% muts2plot$sampleID[substr(muts2plot$paper_id,1,2) == donors2plot[j]]], drop = F]
    if(nrow(aux) > 0){
      aux$sample_gene_cov <- NA
      aux$cov_weighting <- NA
      for(k in 1:length(per_sample_gene_cov)){
        aux$sample_gene_cov[which(aux$sampleID == names(per_sample_gene_cov)[k])] <- as.numeric(per_sample_gene_cov[k])
      }
      aux$cov_weighting <- aux$sample_gene_cov / sum(per_sample_gene_cov)
      
      aux$weighted_cellfraction <- aux$cellfraction * aux$cov_weighting
      aux$weighted_duplex_vaf <- aux$duplex_vaf * aux$cov_weighting
      
      cellfraction[j,c("mis","mislow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact %in% c("Missense","Start_loss","Stop_loss"),c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
      cellfraction[j,c("non","nonlow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="Nonsense",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
      cellfraction[j,c("spl","spllow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="Essential_Splice",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
      cellfraction[j,c("ind","indlow"),x] = colSums(aux[aux$impact=="no-SNV",c("weighted_cellfraction","weighted_duplex_vaf")], na.rm = T)
    }else{
      cellfraction[j,1:8,x] = 0
    }
    nonsyn_lbd$donor[(x-1)*length(donors2plot)+j] <- donors2plot[j]
    nonsyn_lbd$gene[(x-1)*length(donors2plot)+j] <- genes2plot[x]
    nonsyn_lbd$cellfraction[(x-1)*length(donors2plot)+j] <- sum(cellfraction[j,c(5:8),x])
  }
}

# Transpose and reorganise data for plotting
grid = expand.grid(x = rownames(donor_mut_count), y = colnames(donor_mut_count))
grid$z = c(donor_mut_count)
grid_merge <- merge(x=grid,y=nonsyn_lbd, by.x=c("y","x"), by.y=c("donor","gene"))
names(grid_merge)[names(grid_merge) == "cellfraction"] <- "a"
grid_merge$y <- factor(x = grid_merge$y, levels = emseq_LCM_agg$paper_id)
grid_merge$x <- factor(x = grid_merge$x, levels = rev(genes2plot))
grid_merge$a <- as.numeric(grid_merge$a)*100

# Cap the mutant cell fraction at 10% to highlight those in the 1-10% range
grid_merge[which(grid_merge$a > 10),]$a <- 10

# Define colour scheme
color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkorange", "plum3"))

lattice.options(axis.padding=list(factor=0.5)) #remove white border around lattice heatmap
lcm_heatmap <- lattice::levelplot(a~y*x, data = grid_merge, col.regions=color.palette(11001)[c(1,1001:11001)], scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1), x = list(alternating = 3, rot=0)), ylab=" ", xlab = "", colorkey=list(space="top"), at = seq(from = 0, to = 10, by = 0.001), main = list(label = "Polyclonal mutant cell fraction (lower bound %)", cex = 1, side=1, line=0.5, hjust=0.3)) +
  latticeExtra::as.layer(
    lattice::levelplot(z~y*x, grid_merge, col.regions=NA, scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1), x = list(rot=0)), colorkey=list(space="bottom"),
                       panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
                       panel.levelplot(...)
                       panel.text(arg$x, arg$y, arg$z)}))
```

```{r, EDF1C_InterdonorVariabilityLCMSamplesAdditionalInfo, fig.height=12, fig.width=4.5, fig.show='hold'}
# Create disease heatmap

p4 <- levelplot(z~y*x, grid2[which(grid2$x == "Disease"),], col.regions=color.palette, scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, rot = 0), x = list(alternating=3,rot=0)), ylab = NULL, xlab="", colorkey=FALSE)

# Create lymphocyte heatmap
color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","purple"))(101)
p5 <- levelplot(z~y*x, grid2[which(grid2$x == "Lymphocyte %"),], col.regions=color.palette,  at = seq(from = 0, to = 100, by = 1), scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, rot = 0), x = list(rot=0)), ylab = NULL, xlab="", colorkey=FALSE,
                panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
                panel.levelplot(...)
                panel.text(arg$x, arg$y, arg$z, cex = 0.8)})

# Create B cell heatmap
color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","cornflowerblue"))(101)
p6 <- levelplot(z~y*x, grid2[which(grid2$x == "B cell %"),], col.regions=color.palette,  at = seq(from = 0, to = 100, by = 1), scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, rot = 0), x = list(rot=0)), ylab = NULL, xlab="", colorkey=FALSE,
                panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
                panel.levelplot(...)
                panel.text(arg$x, arg$y, arg$z, cex = 0.8)})

# Create T cell heatmap
color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","orchid"))(101)
p7 <- levelplot(z~y*x, grid2[which(grid2$x == "T cell %"),], col.regions=color.palette,  at = seq(from = 0, to = 100, by = 1), scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, rot = 0), x = list(rot=0)), ylab = NULL, xlab="", colorkey=FALSE,
                panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
                panel.levelplot(...)
                panel.text(arg$x, arg$y, arg$z, cex = 0.8)})


# Create sex heatmap
color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("lightblue","lightpink"))
p8 <- levelplot(z~y*x, grid2[which(grid2$x == "Sex"),], col.regions=color.palette, scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, rot = 0), x = list(rot=0)), ylab = NULL, xlab="", colorkey=FALSE)

# Create age heatmap
# Subset grid2 to label with age ranges (plotted as factors)
kk <- grid2[grid2$x == "Age",]
age_factors <- paste0(seq(from = 0, to = 7),"0-",seq(from = 0, to = 7),"9")
kk$k <- NA
for(x in 1:nrow(kk)){
  kk$k[x] <- which(age_factors == kk$z[x])
}
kk$y <- factor(x = kk$y, levels = emseq_LCM_agg$paper_id)
kk <- kk[order(kk$y),]

color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","forestgreen"))(length(age_factors))
p9 <- levelplot(k~y*x, kk, col.regions=color.palette, at=seq(from=0,to=length(age_factors),by = 1), scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, rot = 0), x = list(rot=0)), ylab = NULL, xlab="", colorkey=FALSE,
                panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
                panel.levelplot(...)
                panel.text(arg$x, arg$y, labels = kk$z, col = "black", cex = 0.8)})

# Plot all the heatmaps together (to have the y-axis horizontal, only the first plot p5 needs to have the argument)
if (runman) { dev.new(width=4.5, height=12) }
comb_levObj <- c(p4, p3, p8, p9, p2, p1, p7, p6, p5, lcm_heatmap, layout = c(1, 10), merge.legends = FALSE)
plot(comb_levObj, panel.height = list(c(1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,length(genes2plot)),c("null")))
if (runman) { dev.copy(pdf,"./output/EDF1C_InterdonorVariability_LCM_BcellTcellAnnotated.pdf",width=4.5,height=12); dev.off() }
```

## 12. Withingenednds
### TNFRSF14 withingenedNdS
```{r, Fig3B_WithingenedNdSTNFRSF14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height = 8}
# The disulphide bridges in TNFRSF14 were annotated based on:
# TNFRSF14: https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q92956/entry

# Make additional regions file for disulphide cysteines vs other missense mutations in separate cysteine-rich domains
gene = "TNFRSF14"

load(RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX)
ref_cds_gene_list <- NULL
for(i in 1:length(RefCDS)){
  ref_cds_gene_list <- c(ref_cds_gene_list,RefCDS[[i]]$gene_name)
}

gene_idx <- which(ref_cds_gene_list == gene)

exon_coord <- as.data.frame(RefCDS[[gene_idx]]$intervals_cds)
exon_coord_vec <- NULL
for(x in 1:nrow(exon_coord)){
  exon_coord_vec <- c(exon_coord_vec,exon_coord$V1[x]:exon_coord$V2[x])
}

TNFRSF14_domain <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt = TNFRSF14_domain_json)$feature
TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list <- vector("list", nrow(TNFRSF14_domain))

for(x in 1:nrow(TNFRSF14_domain)){
  CRD_aa <- c(TNFRSF14_domain$location$start$value[TNFRSF14_domain$description == paste("TNFR-Cys",x)]:
                TNFRSF14_domain$location$end$value[TNFRSF14_domain$description ==  paste("TNFR-Cys",x)])
  CRD_cDNA <- rep(((CRD_aa - 1) * 3), each = 3) + 1:3
  TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list[[x]] <- exon_coord_vec[CRD_cDNA]
}

TNFRSF14_ptm <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt = TNFRSF14_ptm_json)$feature
TNFRSF14_ptm <- TNFRSF14_ptm[TNFRSF14_ptm$type == "Disulfide bond",]
TNFRSF14_disulf_aa <- sort(unique(c(TNFRSF14_ptm$location$start$value,TNFRSF14_ptm$location$end$value)))
TNFRSF14_disulf_cDNA <- rep(((TNFRSF14_disulf_aa - 1) * 3), each = 3) + 1:3
TNFRSF14_disulf_pos <- exon_coord_vec[TNFRSF14_disulf_cDNA]

TNFRSF14_disulf_CRD <- NULL
for(x in 1:length(TNFRSF14_disulf_pos)){
  for(y in 1:3){
    if(TNFRSF14_disulf_pos[x] %in% TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list[[y]]){
      TNFRSF14_disulf_CRD[x] <- y
    }
  }
}

for(x in 1:3){
  TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list[[x]] <- TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list[[x]][which(!(TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list[[x]]) %in% TNFRSF14_disulf_pos)]
}

# Create customised withingenednds regions_chr for cysteines involved in disulphide bridges
disulf_regions <- as.data.frame(array(data = NA, dim = c(length(TNFRSF14_disulf_pos),6)))
colnames(disulf_regions) <- c("chr","start","end","wname","impacts","layered")

disulf_regions$chr <- RefCDS[[gene_idx]]$chr
disulf_regions$start <- TNFRSF14_disulf_pos
disulf_regions$end <- TNFRSF14_disulf_pos
disulf_regions$wname <- paste0("wdisulphide_bridges_CRD",TNFRSF14_disulf_CRD)
disulf_regions$impacts <- "Missense"
disulf_regions$layered <- 1

# Create customised withingenednds regions_chr for cysteine-rich domains
CRD_regions <- as.data.frame(array(data = NA, dim = c(length(unlist(TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list)),6)))
colnames(CRD_regions) <- c("chr","start","end","wname","impacts","layered")

CRD_regions$chr <- RefCDS[[gene_idx]]$chr
CRD_regions$start <- unlist(TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list)
CRD_regions$end <- unlist(TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list)
wname_vec <- NULL
for(x in 1:length(TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list)){
  wname_vec <- c(wname_vec,rep(paste0("wCRD",x), times = length(TNFRSF14_CRD_pos_list[[x]])))
}
CRD_regions$wname <- wname_vec
CRD_regions$impacts <- "Missense"
CRD_regions$layered <- 1

# Create customised withingenednds regions_chr for cysteines not involved in disulphide bridges
cys_residues <- which(seqinr::translate(as.vector(RefCDS[[gene_idx]]$seq_cds), numcode = 1) == "C")
cys_cDNA <- rep(((cys_residues - 1) * 3), each = 3) + 1:3
cys_pos_list <- exon_coord_vec[cys_cDNA]
cys_pos_list <- cys_pos_list[which(!(cys_pos_list %in% TNFRSF14_disulf_pos))]

nondisulf_cys_regions <- as.data.frame(array(data = NA, dim = c(length(unlist(cys_pos_list)),6)))
colnames(nondisulf_cys_regions) <- c("chr","start","end","wname","impacts","layered")

nondisulf_cys_regions$chr <- RefCDS[[gene_idx]]$chr
nondisulf_cys_regions$start <- cys_pos_list
nondisulf_cys_regions$end <- cys_pos_list
nondisulf_cys_regions$wname <- "wcysteines_not_in_disulphide_bridges"
nondisulf_cys_regions$impacts <- "Missense"
nondisulf_cys_regions$layered <- 1

custom_regions <- rbind(disulf_regions,CRD_regions,nondisulf_cys_regions)

withingenednds_custom(gene = "TNFRSF14", 
                      per_gene_cov_dir = per_gene_cov_dir,
                      mutations = mutations,
                      refcds_path = RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX,
                      gene_panel = immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")],
                      samples = metadata$sample,
                      custom_regions = custom_regions,
                      genomeFile = genomeFile)

# Save output
nbfix_TNFRSF14 <- nbfix_gene
rm(nbfix_gene)

nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot <- nbfix_TNFRSF14[grepl(paste(c("wmis", "wcys", "wdisulphide_bridges_", "wCRD"),collapse="|"), nbfix_TNFRSF14$name),]
nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name <- gsub("wdisulphide_bridges_CRD1", "Cys-Cys (CRD1)", nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name)
nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name <- gsub("wdisulphide_bridges_CRD2", "Cys-Cys (CRD2)", nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name)
nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name <- gsub("wdisulphide_bridges_CRD3", "Cys-Cys (CRD3)", nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name)
nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name <- gsub("wCRD1", "Missense (CRD1)", nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name)
nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name <- gsub("wCRD2", "Missense (CRD2)", nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name)
nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name <- gsub("wCRD3", "Missense (CRD3)", nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name)
nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name <- gsub("wmis", "All missense", nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name)
nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name <- gsub("wcysteines_not_in_disulphide_bridges", "Cys (free)", nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name)

nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name <- factor(x = nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot$name, levels = c("All missense", "Cys (free)", "Cys-Cys (CRD1)", "Missense (CRD1)", "Cys-Cys (CRD2)", "Missense (CRD2)", "Cys-Cys (CRD3)", "Missense (CRD3)"))

nbfix_plotter(nbfix = nbfix_TNFRSF14_plot, gene = "TNFRSF14", runman = runman, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8)
```

```{r, Additional_WithingenedNdSCCR6,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=2, fig.height=5.5} 
nbfix_plotter(nbfix = nbfix_CCR6_plot, gene = "CCR6", runman = runman, fig.width = 2, fig.height = 5.5)
```

## 13. Pairwise comparison between Hashimoto and Graves samples

```{r Additional_HashimotoGravesPairwisedNdS,message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8, fig.show='hold'}
genes2compare <- immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")]
genes2plot <- c(all_drivers,"RLTPR")
hashi_bulk_IDs <- metadata$sample[which(metadata$pathology == "Hashimoto" & metadata$sample_type == "Bulk")]
graves_bulk_IDs <- metadata$sample[which(metadata$pathology == "Graves" & metadata$sample_type == "Bulk")]

sig_shm_genes <- all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name[which((all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qglobalpos_cv > 0.1 | is.na(all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qglobalpos_cv)) & all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qpos_loc < 0.1 & all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name %in% genes2plot)]
lineage_defining_genes <- "TG"

highlight_colour <- vector()

for(y in 1:length(genes2plot)){
  if(genes2plot[y] %in% sig_shm_genes){
    highlight_colour[y] <- "grey"
  }else if(genes2plot[y] %in% lineage_defining_genes){
    highlight_colour[y] <- "blue"
  }else{
    highlight_colour[y] <- "black"
  }
}
names(highlight_colour) <- genes2plot

driverdensity_sampleIDs <- vector("list", 2)
full_sampleIDs <- vector("list", 2)
combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv <- vector("list",2)
plottitles <- vector("list",2)
temp_muts <- vector("list",2)
unique_temp_muts <- vector("list",2)
temp_cov <- vector("list",2)
dnds_out <- vector("list",2)
pairwise_dnds <- vector("list",2)

driverdensity_sampleIDs[[1]] <- hashi_bulk_IDs
driverdensity_sampleIDs[[2]] <- graves_bulk_IDs

full_sampleIDs[[1]] <- hashi_bulk_IDs
full_sampleIDs[[2]] <- graves_bulk_IDs

plottitles[[1]] <- "Hashimoto bulk samples"
plottitles[[2]] <- "Graves bulk samples"

input_muts <- mutations[,!(colnames(mutations) == "paper_id")]
input_muts$cell_type <- "aitd"

# Run dNdS on Hashimoto bulk samples alone
sample_list <- hashi_bulk_IDs

dnds_muts <- mutations[which(mutations$sampleID %in% sample_list),]
dnds_muts <- dnds_muts[which(!(duplicated(dnds_muts$mut_site))),]

dnds_cov <- rowSums(coverage[which(colnames(coverage) %in% sample_list)])
names(dnds_cov) <- coverage$gene
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(dnds_cov != 0)]
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(!(names(dnds_cov) %in% c("IGLL5","IGLL1")))]
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(names(dnds_cov) %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")])]

hashimoto_bulk_dnds_shm <- dnds_shm(mutations = dnds_muts[,c("sampleID","chr","pos","ref","mut")],
                                    refdb_noshm = RefCDS_noshm_exome,
                                    refdb_shm = RefCDS_shm_exome,
                                    dc_noshm = dnds_cov,
                                    gene_list = names(dnds_cov),
                                    # Exons with just the start codon need to be excluded (synonymous mutations are not possible for dNdSloc)
                                    excl_shm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5","MYO1E","ZNF595","AC026202.1","EHBP1L1"),
                                    excl_noshm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5"),
                                    onesided = T,
                                    maxcovs = 10)

# Run dNdS on Graves bulk samples alone
sample_list <- graves_bulk_IDs

dnds_muts <- mutations[which(mutations$sampleID %in% sample_list),]
dnds_muts <- dnds_muts[which(!(duplicated(dnds_muts$mut_site))),]

dnds_cov <- rowSums(coverage[which(colnames(coverage) %in% sample_list)])
names(dnds_cov) <- coverage$gene
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(dnds_cov != 0)]
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(!(names(dnds_cov) %in% c("IGLL5","IGLL1")))]
dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(names(dnds_cov) %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")])]

grave_bulk_dnds_shm <- dnds_shm(mutations = dnds_muts[,c("sampleID","chr","pos","ref","mut")],
                                    refdb_noshm = RefCDS_noshm_exome,
                                    refdb_shm = RefCDS_shm_exome,
                                    dc_noshm = dnds_cov,
                                    gene_list = names(dnds_cov),
                                    # Exons with just the start codon need to be excluded (synonymous mutations are not possible for dNdSloc)
                                    excl_shm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5","MYO1E","ZNF595","AC026202.1","EHBP1L1"),
                                    excl_noshm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5"),
                                    onesided = T,
                                    maxcovs = 10)

combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv[[1]] <- hashimoto_bulk_dnds_shm$sel_merged
combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv[[2]] <- grave_bulk_dnds_shm$sel_merged

input_cov <- coverage[coverage$gene %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")],]

for(j in 1:2){
  temp_muts[[j]] <- input_muts[which(input_muts$sampleID %in% driverdensity_sampleIDs[[j]]),]
  unique_temp_muts[[j]] <- temp_muts[[j]][which(!(duplicated(temp_muts[[j]]$mut_site))),]
  temp_cov[[j]] <- rowSums(input_cov[which(colnames(input_cov) %in% driverdensity_sampleIDs[[j]])])
  names(temp_cov[[j]]) <- input_cov$gene
  temp_cov[[j]] <- temp_cov[[j]][which(temp_cov[[j]] != 0)]
  temp_cov[[j]] <- temp_cov[[j]][which(!(names(temp_cov[[j]]) %in% c("IGLL1","IGLL5")))]
  
  # NB - Need to run dNdS again as may restrict to different donor list (i.e. individuals aged ≥50)
  # NB - Discuss with Iñigo - pairwise dNdS uses regular dNdS rather than dNdSshm (as genes with nothing but SHM excluded from gene_muts such as LTB)
  dnds_temp <- dndscv(mutations = unique_temp_muts[[j]][,c(1:5)], gene_list = names(temp_cov[[j]]), max_muts_per_gene_per_sample = Inf, max_coding_muts_per_sample = Inf, onesided = T, dc = temp_cov[[j]], refdb = RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX, maxcovs = 10)
  
  kc <- as.vector(dnds_temp$sel_cv$gene_name[which(dnds_temp$sel_cv$qallsubs_cv<0.01)])
  
  dnds_out[[j]] <- dndscv(mutations = unique_temp_muts[[j]][,c(1:5)], gene_list = names(temp_cov[[j]]), max_muts_per_gene_per_sample = Inf, max_coding_muts_per_sample = Inf, onesided = T, dc = temp_cov[[j]], refdb = RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX, kc = kc, maxcovs = 10)
}

pairwise_dnds[[1]] <- pairwise_dNdScv(dnds_out[[1]], dnds_out[[2]], genestotest = genes2compare)
pairwise_dnds[[2]] <- pairwise_dNdScv(dnds_out[[2]], dnds_out[[1]], genestotest = genes2compare)

pairwise_dnds[[1]] <- pairwise_dnds[[1]][pairwise_dnds[[1]]$gene_name %in% genes2plot,]
pairwise_dnds[[2]] <- pairwise_dnds[[2]][pairwise_dnds[[2]]$gene_name %in% genes2plot,]

cell_frac_comp = compplot(
  comp_list = list(c("Hashimoto","Graves")),
  genes2plot = list(genes2plot),
  highlight_colour = list(highlight_colour),
  driverdensity_sampleIDs = list(driverdensity_sampleIDs),
  full_sampleIDs = list(full_sampleIDs),
  muts = input_muts, 
  combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv = list(combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv),
  targeted_dnds_sel_cv = NULL,
  gene2dc_array = input_cov,
  max_duplex_cov = 160000,
  min_mcf_upper = 4.5,
  pairwise_dnds = list(pairwise_dnds),
  runman = runman,
  plottitles = list(plottitles),
  plotfilename = "output/Hashi_Graves_PairwiseComparison.pdf",
  plotwidth = 8,
  plotheight = 8)
```


## 14. Comparison to normal lymphocytes
### Load normal lymphocyte data
```{r LoadNormalLymphocyteData,message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
normal_muts <- read.table(normal_mut_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
normal_cov <- read.table(normal_cov_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
normal_metadata <- read.table(normal_metadata_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
```

```{r ReformatAndAnnotateNormalMuts}
normal_muts$mut_site <- paste(normal_muts$donor,normal_muts$chr,normal_muts$pos,normal_muts$ref,normal_muts$mut,sep = "_")

normal_males <- normal_metadata$sample[which(normal_metadata$sex == "Male")]
normal_muts$cellfraction = normal_muts$duplex_vaf * 2
normal_muts$cellfraction[normal_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & normal_muts$sampleID %in% normal_males] = normal_muts$duplex_vaf[normal_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & normal_muts$sampleID %in% normal_males]

normal_muts$bam_mut_adj = pmax(0,normal_muts$bam_mut-normal_muts$times_called)
normal_muts$bam_cov_adj = normal_muts$bam_cov-normal_muts$duplex_cov
normal_muts$bam_vaf_adj = normal_muts$bam_mut_adj / normal_muts$bam_cov_adj
normal_muts$bam_adj_cellfraction = normal_muts$bam_vaf_adj * 2
normal_muts$bam_adj_cellfraction[normal_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & normal_muts$sampleID %in% normal_males] = normal_muts$bam_vaf_adj[normal_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & normal_muts$sampleID %in% normal_males]
```

### Run pairwise comparison between normal lymphocyte data and thyroid-infiltrating lymphocytes

```{r Fig3D_EDF4_PairwiseComparisonWithNormalLymphocytes,message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8, fig.show='hold'}
# Limit to individuals aged >50 in normal lymphocyte cohort due to large age range
# This makes identification of disease-specific genes very stringent 
# (i.e. higher MCF in disease than pure memory cell populations of older individuals)
sorted_blood_age_cutoff <- 50
lymphocyte_fraction <- 0.25
genes2compare <- immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")]
genes2plot <- c(all_drivers,"RLTPR")

# Comparisons (for bulk, all lymphocyte rich)
# 1. Bulk AITD (>25% lymphocytes) vs PBMC memory B cells  (main)
# 2. Bulk AITD (>25% lymphocytes) vs PBMC memory CD4+ T cells (supp)
# 3. Bulk AITD (>25% lymphocytes) vs PBMC memory CD8+ T cells (supp)
comp_list <- c("B_mem","T_CD4_mem","T_CD8_mem")

# Limit to bulk (not LCM) and samples with lymphocyte fraction >25% in EMseq
aitd_bulk_lymph_IDs <- metadata$sample[metadata$sample_type == "Bulk" & substr(metadata$sample,1,8) %in% substr(emseq$sampleID[(emseq$Blood_B + emseq$Blood_T) > lymphocyte_fraction & emseq$sampleID %in% substr(metadata$sample[metadata$sample_type == "Bulk"],1,16)],1,8)]

for(x in 1:length(comp_list)){
  normal_celltype_IDs <- normal_metadata$sample[grepl(comp_list[x],normal_metadata$cell_type)]
  normal_celltype_age_IDs <- normal_metadata$sample[grepl(comp_list[x],normal_metadata$cell_type) & normal_metadata$age >= sorted_blood_age_cutoff]
  
  sample_list <- normal_celltype_IDs
  
  dnds_muts <- normal_muts[which(normal_muts$sampleID %in% sample_list),]
  dnds_muts <- dnds_muts[which(!(duplicated(dnds_muts$mut_site))),]
  
  dnds_cov <- rowSums(normal_cov[which(colnames(normal_cov) %in% sample_list)])
  names(dnds_cov) <- normal_cov$gene
  dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(dnds_cov != 0)]
  
  # 2024-02-19 - Made decision to exclude IGLL5 and IGLL1 from dNdS analysis. Only reason these Ig genes (but not others) are in the dNdS object is they are in frame.
  dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(!(names(dnds_cov) %in% c("IGLL5","IGLL1")))]
  
  # Restrict dN/dS analysis to genes in targeted panel
  dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(names(dnds_cov) %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")])]
  
  if(comp_list[x] == "B_mem"){
    normal_dnds_shm <- dnds_shm(mutations = dnds_muts[,c("sampleID","chr","pos","ref","mut")],
                                refdb_noshm = RefCDS_noshm_exome,
                                refdb_shm = RefCDS_shm_exome,
                                dc_noshm = dnds_cov,
                                gene_list = names(dnds_cov),
                                # Exons with just the start codon need to be excluded (synonymous mutations are not possible for dNdSloc)
                                excl_shm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5","MYO1E","ZNF595","AC026202.1","EHBP1L1"),
                                excl_noshm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5"),
                                onesided = T,
                                maxcovs = 10)
  }else{
    normal_dnds_cv <- dndscv(mutations = dnds_muts[,c("sampleID","chr","pos","ref","mut")], gene_list = names(dnds_cov), refdb = RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX, max_muts_per_gene_per_sample = Inf, max_coding_muts_per_sample = Inf, maxcovs = 10, onesided = T, dc = dnds_cov)
    
    normal_kc <- normal_dnds_cv$sel_cv$gene_name[normal_dnds_cv$sel_cv$qsubpos_cv < 0.01]
    
    normal_dnds_cv <- dndscv(mutations = dnds_muts[,c("sampleID","chr","pos","ref","mut")], gene_list = names(dnds_cov), refdb = RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX, max_muts_per_gene_per_sample = Inf, max_coding_muts_per_sample = Inf, maxcovs = 10, onesided = T, dc = dnds_cov, kc = normal_kc)
  }
  
  sig_shm_genes <- all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name[which((all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qglobalpos_cv > 0.1 | is.na(all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qglobalpos_cv)) & all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qpos_loc < 0.1 & all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name %in% genes2plot)]
  lineage_defining_genes <- "TG"
  
  highlight_colour <- vector()
  
  for(y in 1:length(genes2plot)){
    if(genes2plot[y] %in% sig_shm_genes){
      highlight_colour[y] <- "grey"
    }else if(genes2plot[y] %in% lineage_defining_genes){
      highlight_colour[y] <- "blue"
    }else{
      highlight_colour[y] <- "black"
    }
  }
  names(highlight_colour) <- genes2plot
  
  driverdensity_sampleIDs <- vector("list", 2)
  full_sampleIDs <- vector("list", 2)
  combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv <- vector("list",2)
  plottitles <- vector("list",2)
  temp_muts <- vector("list",2)
  unique_temp_muts <- vector("list",2)
  temp_cov <- vector("list",2)
  dnds_out <- vector("list",2)
  pairwise_dnds <- vector("list",2)
  
  driverdensity_sampleIDs[[1]] <- aitd_bulk_lymph_IDs
  driverdensity_sampleIDs[[2]] <- normal_celltype_age_IDs
  
  full_sampleIDs[[1]] <- metadata$sample
  full_sampleIDs[[2]] <- normal_celltype_IDs
  
  plottitles[[1]] <- paste0("Autoimmune thyroid\n(>",lymphocyte_fraction * 100,"% lymphocyte fraction)")
  plottitles[[2]] <- paste0("Normal PBMCs - ",comp_list[x],"\n(Individuals aged >",sorted_blood_age_cutoff,")")
  
  input_muts <- mutations[,!(colnames(mutations) == "paper_id")]
  input_muts$cell_type <- "aitd"
  input_muts <- rbind(input_muts,normal_muts[,colnames(input_muts)])
  
  combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv[[1]] <- all_dnds_shm$sel_merged
  
  if(comp_list[x] == "B_mem"){
    combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv[[2]] <- normal_dnds_shm$sel_merged
  }else{
    combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv[[2]] <- normal_dnds_cv$sel_cv
  }
  
  input_cov <- coverage[coverage$gene %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")],]
  input_cov_2 <- normal_cov[normal_cov$gene %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")],]
  rownames(input_cov_2) <- input_cov_2$gene
  input_cov <- cbind(input_cov,input_cov_2[input_cov$gene,!(colnames(input_cov_2) == "gene")])
  
  for(j in 1:2){
    temp_muts[[j]] <- input_muts[which(input_muts$sampleID %in% driverdensity_sampleIDs[[j]]),]
    unique_temp_muts[[j]] <- temp_muts[[j]][which(!(duplicated(temp_muts[[j]]$mut_site))),]
    temp_cov[[j]] <- rowSums(input_cov[which(colnames(input_cov) %in% driverdensity_sampleIDs[[j]])])
    names(temp_cov[[j]]) <- input_cov$gene
    temp_cov[[j]] <- temp_cov[[j]][which(temp_cov[[j]] != 0)]
    temp_cov[[j]] <- temp_cov[[j]][which(!(names(temp_cov[[j]]) %in% c("IGLL1","IGLL5")))]
    
    # NB - Need to run dNdS again as may restrict to different donor list (i.e. individuals aged ≥50)
    # NB - Discuss with Iñigo - pairwise dNdS uses regular dNdS rather than dNdSshm (as genes with nothing but SHM excluded from gene_muts such as LTB)
    dnds_temp <- dndscv(mutations = unique_temp_muts[[j]][,c(1:5)], gene_list = names(temp_cov[[j]]), max_muts_per_gene_per_sample = Inf, max_coding_muts_per_sample = Inf, onesided = T, dc = temp_cov[[j]], refdb = RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX, maxcovs = 10)
    
    kc <- as.vector(dnds_temp$sel_cv$gene_name[which(dnds_temp$sel_cv$qallsubs_cv<0.01)])
    
    dnds_out[[j]] <- dndscv(mutations = unique_temp_muts[[j]][,c(1:5)], gene_list = names(temp_cov[[j]]), max_muts_per_gene_per_sample = Inf, max_coding_muts_per_sample = Inf, onesided = T, dc = temp_cov[[j]], refdb = RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX, kc = kc, maxcovs = 10)
  }
  
  pairwise_dnds[[1]] <- pairwise_dNdScv(dnds_out[[1]], dnds_out[[2]], genestotest = genes2compare)
  pairwise_dnds[[2]] <- pairwise_dNdScv(dnds_out[[2]], dnds_out[[1]], genestotest = genes2compare)
  
  pairwise_dnds[[1]] <- pairwise_dnds[[1]][pairwise_dnds[[1]]$gene_name %in% genes2plot,]
  pairwise_dnds[[2]] <- pairwise_dnds[[2]][pairwise_dnds[[2]]$gene_name %in% genes2plot,]
  
  cell_frac_comp = compplot(
    comp_list = list(c("aitd",comp_list[x])),
    genes2plot = list(genes2plot),
    highlight_colour = list(highlight_colour),
    driverdensity_sampleIDs = list(driverdensity_sampleIDs),
    full_sampleIDs = list(full_sampleIDs),
    muts = input_muts, 
    combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv = list(combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv),
    targeted_dnds_sel_cv = NULL,
    gene2dc_array = input_cov,
    max_duplex_cov = 160000,
    min_mcf_upper = 4.5,
    pairwise_dnds = list(pairwise_dnds),
    runman = runman,
    plottitles = list(plottitles),
    plotfilename = paste0("output/Fig3D_EDF4_NonSynonymousMutantFractionComparison_HashimotoLymphocyteRich_NormalPBMC_",comp_list[x],".pdf"),
    plotwidth = 8,
    plotheight = 8)
}
```

```{r ReformatAndAnnotateOtherControlSampleMuts}
lymph_node_muts$cellfraction[lymph_node_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & lymph_node_muts$sampleID %in% lymph_node_males] = lymph_node_muts$duplex_vaf[lymph_node_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & lymph_node_muts$sampleID %in% lymph_node_males]

lymph_node_muts$bam_mut_adj = pmax(0,lymph_node_muts$bam_mut-lymph_node_muts$times_called)
lymph_node_muts$bam_cov_adj = lymph_node_muts$bam_cov-lymph_node_muts$duplex_cov
lymph_node_muts$bam_vaf_adj = lymph_node_muts$bam_mut_adj / lymph_node_muts$bam_cov_adj
lymph_node_muts$bam_adj_cellfraction = lymph_node_muts$bam_vaf_adj * 2
lymph_node_muts$bam_adj_cellfraction[lymph_node_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & lymph_node_muts$sampleID %in% lymph_node_males] = lymph_node_muts$bam_vaf_adj[lymph_node_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & lymph_node_muts$sampleID %in% lymph_node_males]

spleen_muts$donor <- substr(spleen_muts$sampleID,1,7)
spleen_muts$mut_site <- paste(spleen_muts$donor,spleen_muts$chr,spleen_muts$pos,spleen_muts$ref,spleen_muts$mut,sep = "_")
spleen_males <- spleen_metadata$sample[which(spleen_metadata$sex == "Male")]
spleen_muts$cellfraction = spleen_muts$duplex_vaf * 2
spleen_muts$cellfraction[spleen_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & spleen_muts$sampleID %in% spleen_males] = spleen_muts$duplex_vaf[spleen_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & spleen_muts$sampleID %in% spleen_males]

spleen_muts$bam_mut_adj = pmax(0,spleen_muts$bam_mut-spleen_muts$times_called)
spleen_muts$bam_cov_adj = spleen_muts$bam_cov-spleen_muts$duplex_cov
spleen_muts$bam_vaf_adj = spleen_muts$bam_mut_adj / spleen_muts$bam_cov_adj
spleen_muts$bam_adj_cellfraction = spleen_muts$bam_vaf_adj * 2
spleen_muts$bam_adj_cellfraction[spleen_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & spleen_muts$sampleID %in% spleen_males] = spleen_muts$bam_vaf_adj[spleen_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & spleen_muts$sampleID %in% spleen_males]

tonsillitis_muts$donor <- substr(tonsillitis_muts$sampleID,1,7)
tonsillitis_muts$mut_site <- paste(tonsillitis_muts$donor,tonsillitis_muts$chr,tonsillitis_muts$pos,tonsillitis_muts$ref,tonsillitis_muts$mut,sep = "_")
tonsillitis_males <- tonsillitis_metadata$sample[which(tonsillitis_metadata$sex == "Male")]
tonsillitis_muts$cellfraction = tonsillitis_muts$duplex_vaf * 2
tonsillitis_muts$cellfraction[tonsillitis_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & tonsillitis_muts$sampleID %in% tonsillitis_males] = tonsillitis_muts$duplex_vaf[tonsillitis_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & tonsillitis_muts$sampleID %in% tonsillitis_males]

tonsillitis_muts$bam_mut_adj = pmax(0,tonsillitis_muts$bam_mut-tonsillitis_muts$times_called)
tonsillitis_muts$bam_cov_adj = tonsillitis_muts$bam_cov-tonsillitis_muts$duplex_cov
tonsillitis_muts$bam_vaf_adj = tonsillitis_muts$bam_mut_adj / tonsillitis_muts$bam_cov_adj
tonsillitis_muts$bam_adj_cellfraction = tonsillitis_muts$bam_vaf_adj * 2
tonsillitis_muts$bam_adj_cellfraction[tonsillitis_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & tonsillitis_muts$sampleID %in% tonsillitis_males] = tonsillitis_muts$bam_vaf_adj[tonsillitis_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & tonsillitis_muts$sampleID %in% tonsillitis_males]

thyroid_goitre_muts$donor <- substr(thyroid_goitre_muts$sampleID,1,7)
thyroid_goitre_muts$mut_site <- paste(thyroid_goitre_muts$donor,thyroid_goitre_muts$chr,thyroid_goitre_muts$pos,thyroid_goitre_muts$ref,thyroid_goitre_muts$mut,sep = "_")
thyroid_goitre_males <- thyroid_goitre_metadata$sample[which(thyroid_goitre_metadata$sex == "Male")]
thyroid_goitre_muts$cellfraction = thyroid_goitre_muts$duplex_vaf * 2
thyroid_goitre_muts$cellfraction[thyroid_goitre_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & thyroid_goitre_muts$sampleID %in% thyroid_goitre_males] = thyroid_goitre_muts$duplex_vaf[thyroid_goitre_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & thyroid_goitre_muts$sampleID %in% thyroid_goitre_males]

thyroid_goitre_muts$bam_mut_adj = pmax(0,thyroid_goitre_muts$bam_mut-thyroid_goitre_muts$times_called)
thyroid_goitre_muts$bam_cov_adj = thyroid_goitre_muts$bam_cov-thyroid_goitre_muts$duplex_cov
thyroid_goitre_muts$bam_vaf_adj = thyroid_goitre_muts$bam_mut_adj / thyroid_goitre_muts$bam_cov_adj

thyroid_goitre_muts$bam_adj_cellfraction[thyroid_goitre_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & thyroid_goitre_muts$sampleID %in% thyroid_goitre_males] = thyroid_goitre_muts$bam_vaf_adj[thyroid_goitre_muts$chr %in% c("X","Y") & thyroid_goitre_muts$sampleID %in% thyroid_goitre_males]
```
