### Run pairwise comparison between other control sample data and thyroid-infiltrating lymphocytes

```{r EDF4_PairwiseComparisonWithOtherControlSamples,message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8, fig.show='hold'}
lymphocyte_fraction <- 0.25
genes2compare <- immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot" & immune_genes$chr != "Y")]
genes2plot <- c(all_drivers,"RLTPR")

# Comparisons (for bulk, all lymphocyte rich)
# 1. Bulk AITD (>25% lymphocytes) vs LCM lymphocytes
# 2. Bulk AITD (>25% lymphocytes) vs lymph nodes
# 3. Bulk AITD (>25% lymphocytes) vs spleen
# 4. Bulk AITD (>25% lymphocytes) vs tonsillitis
# 5. Bulk AITD (>25% lymphocytes) vs thyroid goitre
comp_list <- c("lcm_lymphocyte","lymph_node","spleen","tonsillitis","thyroid_goitre")
plot_titles <- c("LCM lymphocyte aggregates","Lymph node","Spleen","Tonsillitis","Thyroid goitre")

# Limit to bulk (not LCM) and samples with lymphocyte fraction >25% in EMseq
aitd_bulk_lymph_IDs <- metadata$sample[metadata$sample_type == "Bulk" & substr(metadata$sample,1,8) %in% substr(emseq$sampleID[(emseq$Blood_B + emseq$Blood_T) > lymphocyte_fraction & emseq$sampleID %in% substr(metadata$sample[metadata$sample_type == "Bulk"],1,16)],1,8)]

for(x in 1:length(comp_list)){
  other_normal_muts <- eval(parse(text = paste0(comp_list[x],"_muts")))
  other_normal_metadata <- eval(parse(text = paste0(comp_list[x],"_metadata")))
  other_normal_cov <- eval(parse(text = paste0(comp_list[x],"_cov")))
  
  other_normal_IDs <- other_normal_metadata$sample
  
  sample_list <- other_normal_IDs
  
  dnds_muts <- other_normal_muts[which(other_normal_muts$sampleID %in% sample_list),]
  dnds_muts <- dnds_muts[which(!(duplicated(dnds_muts$mut_site))),]
  
  dnds_cov <- rowSums(other_normal_cov[which(colnames(other_normal_cov) %in% sample_list)])
  names(dnds_cov) <- other_normal_cov$gene
  dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(dnds_cov != 0)]
  
  # 2024-02-19 - Made decision to exclude IGLL5 and IGLL1 from dNdS analysis. Only reason these Ig genes (but not others) are in the dNdS object is they are in frame.
  dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(!(names(dnds_cov) %in% c("IGLL5","IGLL1")))]
  
  # Restrict dN/dS analysis to genes in targeted panel
  dnds_cov <- dnds_cov[which(names(dnds_cov) %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")])]
  
  other_normal_dnds_shm <- dnds_shm(mutations = dnds_muts[,c("sampleID","chr","pos","ref","mut")],
                                    refdb_noshm = RefCDS_noshm_exome,
                                    refdb_shm = RefCDS_shm_exome,
                                    dc_noshm = dnds_cov,
                                    gene_list = names(dnds_cov),
                                    # Exons with just the start codon need to be excluded (synonymous mutations are not possible for dNdSloc)
                                    excl_shm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5","MYO1E","ZNF595","AC026202.1","EHBP1L1"),
                                    excl_noshm = c("IGLL1","IGLL5"),
                                    onesided = T,
                                    maxcovs = 10)
  
  sig_shm_genes <- all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name[which((all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qglobalpos_cv > 0.1 | is.na(all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qglobalpos_cv)) & all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$qpos_loc < 0.1 & all_dnds_shm$sel_merged$gene_name %in% genes2plot)]
  lineage_defining_genes <- "TG"
  
  highlight_colour <- vector()
  
  for(y in 1:length(genes2plot)){
    if(genes2plot[y] %in% sig_shm_genes){
      highlight_colour[y] <- "grey"
    }else if(genes2plot[y] %in% lineage_defining_genes){
      highlight_colour[y] <- "blue"
    }else{
      highlight_colour[y] <- "black"
    }
  }
  names(highlight_colour) <- genes2plot
  
  driverdensity_sampleIDs <- vector("list", 2)
  full_sampleIDs <- vector("list", 2)
  combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv <- vector("list",2)
  plottitles <- vector("list",2)
  temp_muts <- vector("list",2)
  unique_temp_muts <- vector("list",2)
  temp_cov <- vector("list",2)
  dnds_out <- vector("list",2)
  pairwise_dnds <- vector("list",2)
  
  driverdensity_sampleIDs[[1]] <- aitd_bulk_lymph_IDs
  driverdensity_sampleIDs[[2]] <- other_normal_IDs
  
  full_sampleIDs[[1]] <- metadata$sample
  full_sampleIDs[[2]] <- other_normal_IDs
  
  plottitles[[1]] <- paste0("Autoimmune thyroid\n(>",lymphocyte_fraction * 100,"% lymphocyte fraction)")
  plottitles[[2]] <- plot_titles[x]
  
  input_muts <- mutations[,!(colnames(mutations) == "paper_id")]
  input_muts <- rbind(input_muts,other_normal_muts[,colnames(input_muts)])
  
  combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv[[1]] <- all_dnds_shm$sel_merged
  combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv[[2]] <- other_normal_dnds_shm$sel_merged
  
  input_cov <- coverage[coverage$gene %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")],]
  input_cov_2 <- other_normal_cov[other_normal_cov$gene %in% immune_genes$gene[which(immune_genes$target_type != "Hotspot")],]
  rownames(input_cov_2) <- input_cov_2$gene
  input_cov <- cbind(input_cov,input_cov_2[input_cov$gene,!(colnames(input_cov_2) == "gene")])
  
  for(j in 1:2){
    temp_muts[[j]] <- input_muts[which(input_muts$sampleID %in% driverdensity_sampleIDs[[j]]),]
    unique_temp_muts[[j]] <- temp_muts[[j]][which(!(duplicated(temp_muts[[j]]$mut_site))),]
    temp_cov[[j]] <- rowSums(input_cov[which(colnames(input_cov) %in% driverdensity_sampleIDs[[j]])])
    names(temp_cov[[j]]) <- input_cov$gene
    temp_cov[[j]] <- temp_cov[[j]][which(temp_cov[[j]] != 0)]
    temp_cov[[j]] <- temp_cov[[j]][which(!(names(temp_cov[[j]]) %in% c("IGLL1","IGLL5")))]
    
    # NB - Need to run dNdS again as may restrict to different donor list (i.e. individuals aged ≥50)
    # NB - Discuss with Iñigo - pairwise dNdS uses regular dNdS rather than dNdSshm (as genes with nothing but SHM excluded from gene_muts such as LTB)
    dnds_temp <- dndscv(mutations = unique_temp_muts[[j]][,c(1:5)], gene_list = names(temp_cov[[j]]), max_muts_per_gene_per_sample = Inf, max_coding_muts_per_sample = Inf, onesided = T, dc = temp_cov[[j]], refdb = RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX, maxcovs = 10)
    
    kc <- as.vector(dnds_temp$sel_cv$gene_name[which(dnds_temp$sel_cv$qallsubs_cv<0.01)])
    
    dnds_out[[j]] <- dndscv(mutations = unique_temp_muts[[j]][,c(1:5)], gene_list = names(temp_cov[[j]]), max_muts_per_gene_per_sample = Inf, max_coding_muts_per_sample = Inf, onesided = T, dc = temp_cov[[j]], refdb = RefCDS_GRCh37_NSX, kc = kc, maxcovs = 10)
  }
  
  pairwise_dnds[[1]] <- pairwise_dNdScv(dnds_out[[1]], dnds_out[[2]], genestotest = genes2compare)
  pairwise_dnds[[2]] <- pairwise_dNdScv(dnds_out[[2]], dnds_out[[1]], genestotest = genes2compare)
  
  pairwise_dnds[[1]] <- pairwise_dnds[[1]][pairwise_dnds[[1]]$gene_name %in% genes2plot,]
  pairwise_dnds[[2]] <- pairwise_dnds[[2]][pairwise_dnds[[2]]$gene_name %in% genes2plot,]
  
  cell_frac_comp = compplot(
    comp_list = list(c("aitd",comp_list[x])),
    genes2plot = list(genes2plot),
    highlight_colour = list(highlight_colour),
    driverdensity_sampleIDs = list(driverdensity_sampleIDs),
    full_sampleIDs = list(full_sampleIDs),
    muts = input_muts, 
    combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv = list(combined_targeted_only_dnds_sel_cv),
    targeted_dnds_sel_cv = NULL,
    gene2dc_array = input_cov,
    max_duplex_cov = 160000,
    min_mcf_upper = 4.5,
    pairwise_dnds = list(pairwise_dnds),
    runman = runman,
    plottitles = list(plottitles),
    plotfilename = paste0("output/EDF4_NonSynonymousMutantFractionComparison_HashimotoLymphocyteRich_other_normal_",comp_list[x],".pdf"),
    plotwidth = 8,
    plotheight = 8)
}
```

```{r Fig3C_MutantCellFractionControlCohorts, fig.width = 10, fig.height=10}
plot_categories <- c("AITD_LymphocyteAbove25Pct","PBMC_Bmem_AgedOver50","Spleen","LymphNode","Tonsillitis","LCM_Lymphoid_Aggregates","ThyroidGoitre")

genes2plot <- c("TNFRSF14","CD274")

lymphocyte_fraction <- 0.25
sorted_blood_age_cutoff <- 50

plot_sample_lists <- list()

plot_sample_lists[[1]] <- metadata$sample[metadata$sample_type == "Bulk" & substr(metadata$sample,1,8) %in% substr(emseq$sampleID[(emseq$Blood_B + emseq$Blood_T) > lymphocyte_fraction & emseq$sampleID %in% substr(metadata$sample[metadata$sample_type == "Bulk"],1,16)],1,8)]
plot_sample_lists[[2]] <- normal_metadata$sample[normal_metadata$age >= sorted_blood_age_cutoff & grepl("B_mem",normal_metadata$cell_type)]
plot_sample_lists[[3]] <- spleen_metadata$sample
plot_sample_lists[[4]] <- lymph_node_metadata$sample
plot_sample_lists[[5]] <- tonsillitis_metadata$sample
plot_sample_lists[[6]] <- lcm_lymphocyte_metadata$sample
plot_sample_lists[[7]] <- thyroid_goitre_metadata$sample

plot_donor_lists <- list()
for(j in 1:length(plot_categories)){
  plot_donor_lists[[j]] <- unique(substr(plot_sample_lists[[j]],1,7))
}

plot_mut_vec <- c("mutations","normal_muts","spleen_muts","lymph_node_muts","tonsillitis_muts","lcm_lymphocyte_muts","thyroid_goitre_muts")
plot_cov_vec <- c("coverage","normal_cov","spleen_cov","lymph_node_cov","tonsillitis_cov","lcm_lymphocyte_cov","thyroid_goitre_cov")

per_donor_cell_fraction <- array(data = NA, dim = c(length(unlist(plot_donor_lists)),7,length(genes2plot)))
dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction) <- list(paste(rep(c(1:length(plot_categories)),times = lengths(plot_donor_lists)),unlist(plot_donor_lists),sep = "_"),c("category_no","category","donor","gene","duplexcov","cellfraction_low","cellfraction_high"),genes2plot)

for(x in 1:length(plot_categories)){
  for(y in 1:length(genes2plot)){
    per_donor_cell_fraction[which(grepl(paste0(x,"_"),unlist(dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1]))),"category_no",y] <- x
    per_donor_cell_fraction[which(grepl(paste0(x,"_"),unlist(dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1]))),"category",y] <- plot_categories[x]
    per_donor_cell_fraction[which(grepl(paste0(x,"_"),unlist(dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1]))),"donor",y] <- plot_donor_lists[[x]]
    per_donor_cell_fraction[which(grepl(paste0(x,"_"),unlist(dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1]))),"gene",y] <- genes2plot[y]
    for(z in 1:length(plot_donor_lists[[x]])){
      donor_sample_list <- plot_sample_lists[[x]][which(substr(plot_sample_lists[[x]],1,7) == plot_donor_lists[[x]][z])]
      muts2plot <- eval(parse(text = plot_mut_vec[x]))
      muts2plot <- muts2plot[which(muts2plot$sampleID %in% donor_sample_list & muts2plot$gene == genes2plot[y] & muts2plot$impact != "Synonymous"),,drop = F]
      per_sample_gene_cov <- eval(parse(text = plot_cov_vec[x]))
      per_sample_gene_cov <- per_sample_gene_cov[which(per_sample_gene_cov$gene == genes2plot[y]),colnames(per_sample_gene_cov) %in% donor_sample_list,drop = F]
      
      per_donor_cell_fraction[which(grepl(paste0(x,"_"),unlist(dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1])))[z],"duplexcov",y] <- sum(per_sample_gene_cov)
      if(nrow(muts2plot) > 0){
      aux <- muts2plot[,c("sampleID","cellfraction","duplex_vaf"),drop = F]
      aux$sample_gene_cov <- NA
      aux$cov_weighting <- NA
      for(k in 1:length(per_sample_gene_cov)){
        aux$sample_gene_cov[which(aux$sampleID == names(per_sample_gene_cov)[k])] <- as.numeric(per_sample_gene_cov[k])
      }
      aux$cov_weighting <- aux$sample_gene_cov / sum(per_sample_gene_cov)
      
      aux$weighted_cellfraction <- aux$cellfraction * aux$cov_weighting
      aux$weighted_duplex_vaf <- aux$duplex_vaf * aux$cov_weighting
      
      per_donor_cell_fraction[which(grepl(paste0(x,"_"),unlist(dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1])))[z],"cellfraction_low",y] <- sum(aux$weighted_duplex_vaf)
      per_donor_cell_fraction[which(grepl(paste0(x,"_"),unlist(dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1])))[z],"cellfraction_high",y] <- sum(aux$weighted_cellfraction)
      } else{
        per_donor_cell_fraction[which(grepl(paste0(x,"_"),unlist(dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1])))[z],"cellfraction_low",y] <- 0
      per_donor_cell_fraction[which(grepl(paste0(x,"_"),unlist(dimnames(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1])))[z],"cellfraction_high",y] <- 0
      }
    }
  }
}

per_donor_cell_fraction_df <- data.frame(array(data = NA, dim = c(dim(per_donor_cell_fraction)[1]*dim(per_donor_cell_fraction)[3],dim(per_donor_cell_fraction)[2])))
for(j in 1:length(genes2plot)){
    if(j == 1){
      colnames(per_donor_cell_fraction_df) <- colnames(per_donor_cell_fraction[,,1])
      per_donor_cell_fraction_df[1:nrow(per_donor_cell_fraction[,,1]),] <- per_donor_cell_fraction[,,j]
    }else{
      per_donor_cell_fraction_df[(((j - 1) * nrow(per_donor_cell_fraction[,,1])) + 1):(j * nrow(per_donor_cell_fraction[,,1])),] <- per_donor_cell_fraction[,,j]
    }
}

per_donor_cell_fraction_df$category_no <- as.numeric(per_donor_cell_fraction_df$category_no)
per_donor_cell_fraction_df$duplexcov <- as.numeric(per_donor_cell_fraction_df$duplexcov)
per_donor_cell_fraction_df$cellfraction_low <- as.numeric(per_donor_cell_fraction_df$cellfraction_low)
per_donor_cell_fraction_df$cellfraction_high <- as.numeric(per_donor_cell_fraction_df$cellfraction_high)

per_category_cell_fraction_df <- data.frame(array(data = NA, dim = c(length(plot_categories)*length(genes2plot),5)))
colnames(per_category_cell_fraction_df) <- c("category_no","category","gene","cellfraction_low","cellfraction_high")
for(j in 1:length(genes2plot)){
  for(k in 1:length(plot_categories)){
    per_category_cell_fraction_df$category_no[(j-1)*length(plot_categories) + k] <- k
    per_category_cell_fraction_df$category[(j-1)*length(plot_categories) + k] <- plot_categories[k]
    per_category_cell_fraction_df$gene[(j-1)*length(plot_categories) + k] <- genes2plot[j]
    aux <- per_donor_cell_fraction_df[which(per_donor_cell_fraction_df$category_no == k & per_donor_cell_fraction_df$gene == genes2plot[j]),]
    aux$cov_weighting <- aux$duplexcov / sum(aux$duplexcov)
    aux$weighted_cellfraction_low <- aux$cellfraction_low * aux$cov_weighting
    aux$weighted_cellfraction_high <- aux$cellfraction_high * aux$cov_weighting
    per_category_cell_fraction_df$cellfraction_low[(j-1)*length(plot_categories) + k] <- sum(aux$weighted_cellfraction_low)
    per_category_cell_fraction_df$cellfraction_high[(j-1)*length(plot_categories) + k] <- sum(aux$weighted_cellfraction_high)
  }
}

per_donor_cell_fraction_df$midpoint <- 100 * ((per_donor_cell_fraction_df$cellfraction_high + per_donor_cell_fraction_df$cellfraction_low) / 2)

aux <- array(data = NA, dim = c(length(genes2plot),length(plot_categories),2))
dimnames(aux) <- list(genes2plot,1:length(plot_categories),c("cellfraction_low","cellfraction_high"))
for(j in 1:length(genes2plot)){
  for(k in 1:length(plot_categories)){
    aux[j,k,1] <- 100 * per_category_cell_fraction_df[which(per_category_cell_fraction_df$category_no == k & per_category_cell_fraction_df$gene == genes2plot[j]),"cellfraction_low"]
    aux[j,k,2] <- 100 * per_category_cell_fraction_df[which(per_category_cell_fraction_df$category_no == k & per_category_cell_fraction_df$gene == genes2plot[j]),"cellfraction_high"]
    if(aux[j,k,1] <= 0.1){
      aux[j,k,1] <- 0.1
    }
    if(aux[j,k,2] <= 0.1){
      aux[j,k,2] <- 0.105
    }
  }
}

per_donor_cell_fraction_df$midpoint[per_donor_cell_fraction_df$midpoint < 0.1] <- 0.1

if (runman) { dev.new(width=10, height=10) }
par(mar = c(15.1,4.1,4.1,2.1))
pos = barplot(aux[,,2], names = plot_categories, beside = T,las = 2, col = c("firebrick","steelblue"), border = NA, ylim = c(0.08,52), ylab = "Mutant cell fraction", log = "y")
barplot(aux[,,1], beside = T,las = 2, col = c(rep("white", times = 2)), names = plot_categories, ylim = c(0.08,52), add = T, border = "white", log = "y")
for(j in 1:length(plot_categories)){
  for(k in 1:length(genes2plot)){
      points(x = jitter(pos[k,per_donor_cell_fraction_df[which(per_donor_cell_fraction_df$category_no == j & per_donor_cell_fraction_df$gene == genes2plot[k]),"category_no"]], amount = 0.2),y = per_donor_cell_fraction_df[which(per_donor_cell_fraction_df$category_no == j & per_donor_cell_fraction_df$gene == genes2plot[k]),"midpoint"], pch=21,bg=c("firebrick","steelblue")[k],col = "black",cex = 1)
  }
}
text(x = pos[1,ncol(pos)], y = rep(50,times = length(genes2plot)) * c(0.8^seq(from = 1,to = length(genes2plot), by = 1)), labels = genes2plot, col=c("firebrick","steelblue"))
if (runman) { dev.copy(pdf,"./output/Fig3C_MutantCellFractionControlCohorts.pdf",width=10,height=10); dev.off() }
```

```{r CalculateMutantBcellFraction}

aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction <- per_donor_cell_fraction_df[which(per_donor_cell_fraction_df$category == "AITD_LymphocyteAbove25Pct"),]

aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$paper_id <- NA
aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$estimated_B_cell_prop <- NA

for(j in 1:nrow(aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction)){
  aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$paper_id[j] <- unique(substr(metadata$paper_id[which(metadata$donor == aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$donor[j])],1,2))
  aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$estimated_B_cell_prop[j] <- mean(emseq_bulk$Blood_B[which(emseq_bulk$paper_id == aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$paper_id[j])])
}
aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$mut_B_cell_fraction_low <- 100 * (aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$cellfraction_low / aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$estimated_B_cell_prop)
aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$mut_B_cell_fraction_mid <- 100 * ((aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$midpoint / 100) / aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$estimated_B_cell_prop)
aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$mut_B_cell_fraction_high <- 100 * (aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$cellfraction_high / aitd_mut_b_cell_fraction$estimated_B_cell_prop)
```

## 16a. Spatial mapping

Four donors were studied further with laser capture microdissection and whole exome sequencing. We then piled up variants called in matched bulk samples with NanoSeq, in the microdissected whole exomes. This enables the spatial mapping of mutations. 

Run function across all mutations to map these to whole exomes that have been piled up gene-wide from microdissections. This function creates a folder for each donor in the  directory: ./output/spatial_mapping/

Genes with pileup data: TNFRSF14, CD274, CCR6, TET2, CBL (PD66718 only), DNMT3A (PD66718 only)

## 17. Single nucleus DNA sequencing from donor H1

For each nucleus, we generated a PTA sequencing library. We initially carried out targeted sequencing using the same panel of 725 genes used for targeted NanoSeq. For a subset of nuclei (all cells from the first plate, solely B cells from the second plate), we also carried out whole genome sequencing. The targeted PTA data is referred to as “DNAhyb”.

Mutations called by targeted NanoSeq were genotyped in the DNAHyb PTA data. The filtered mutations table shows those genotyped mutations with convincing support (i.e. VAF ≥ 0.25 & total depth ≥ 10).

```{r LoadPTAData, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pta_additional_annotation_H1 <- read.table(pta_additional_annotation_H1_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1 <- read.table(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
```

A small number of mutations were also identified by manually reviewing TNFRSF14 and CD274 loci in IGV. These rescued mutations are merged with the genotyped targeted NanoSeq mutations.

```{r IncorporateRescuedPTAmuts, message=FALSE}
pta_dna_hyb_rescued_muts_H1 <- read_xlsx(pta_dna_hyb_rescued_muts_H1_file)
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1 <- rbind(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1, pta_dna_hyb_rescued_muts_H1)
```

CD274 intron 1 splice site mutations are not annotated by dNdScv as they lie outside the coding region but are still expected to be high impact mutations. Manually change the annotation for a CD274 intron 1 splice site mutation to include it in the heatmap.

```{r RescueCD274Intron1SpliceSite}
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$gene[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$chr == "9" & pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$pos == 5456097)] <- "CD274"
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$impact[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$chr == "9" & pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$pos == 5456097)] <- "Essential_Splice"
```

Cell 41 has a mutation affecting the polypyrimidine tract in intron 1 of CD274. This is predicted to disrupt splicing with high confidence by SpliceAI (acceptor loss delta score = 0.92). Therefore, we have also manually changed the annotation for this mutation to include it in the heatmap.

```{r RescueCD274PolypyrimidineTractMutation}
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$gene[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$chr == "9" & pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$pos == 5456084)] <- "CD274"
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$impact[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$chr == "9" & pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$pos == 5456084)] <- "Essential_Splice"
```

Immune loci captured by targeted panel:
TCRA: 14:22180451-23021069
TCRB: 7: 142000802-142511002
IGH: 14:106053233-106586330
IGLL5: 22:23230233-23237874

Mature B cells should have a significant proportion of genotyped mutations occurring within heavy and light chain Ig loci. We include the full V(D)J chromosomal regions for identifying genotyped Ig SHM mutations in the code below, as the captured region can act as an anchor for other portions of the Ig locus that are not directly captured. We therefore consider the Ig loci to be:

Full immune loci
IGH: 14:106053226-107288019
IGL: 22:22380474-23265203

```{r EDF6B_IdentifyMatureBcellsBySHM, fig.height=3, fig.width=9, warnings = FALSE}
pta_additional_annotation_H1$total_muts <- NA
pta_additional_annotation_H1$muts_in_immune_loci <- NA

for(x in 1:nrow(pta_additional_annotation_H1)){
  temp_muts <- pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1[which(gsub("_dnahyb.*","",pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$id) == pta_additional_annotation_H1$well_ID[x]),]
  
  pta_additional_annotation_H1$total_muts[x] <- nrow(temp_muts)
  pta_additional_annotation_H1$muts_in_immune_loci[x] <- length(which(((temp_muts$chr == "14" & temp_muts$pos >= 106053226 & temp_muts$pos <= 107288019)|(temp_muts$chr == "22" & temp_muts$pos >= 22380474 & temp_muts$pos <= 23265203))))
}

pta_additional_annotation_H1$prop_immune_loci <- pta_additional_annotation_H1$muts_in_immune_loci / pta_additional_annotation_H1$total_muts
pta_additional_annotation_H1$prop_immune_loci[which(is.nan(pta_additional_annotation_H1$prop_immune_loci))] <- 0

pta_additional_annotation_H1$celltype_SHM <- NA
pta_additional_annotation_H1$celltype_SHM[pta_additional_annotation_H1$prop_immune_loci >= 0.1 & pta_additional_annotation_H1$muts_in_immune_loci >= 3] <- "Mature B cell"
pta_additional_annotation_H1$celltype_SHM[(pta_additional_annotation_H1$prop_immune_loci < 0.1 & pta_additional_annotation_H1$prop_immune_loci > 0) | (pta_additional_annotation_H1$muts_in_immune_loci < 3 & pta_additional_annotation_H1$muts_in_immune_loci > 0)] <- "Uncertain"
pta_additional_annotation_H1$celltype_SHM[pta_additional_annotation_H1$muts_in_immune_loci == 0] <- "Not mature B cell"

ggplot(pta_additional_annotation_H1[!(is.nan(pta_additional_annotation_H1$prop_immune_loci)),]) +
  geom_point((aes(x = muts_in_immune_loci, y = prop_immune_loci, color = celltype_VDJ_recomb)), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3, colour = "red", lty = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.1, colour = "red", lty = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,1), limits = c(0,80)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0.01), limits = c(0,1)) +
  labs(x = "Number of immune loci mutations", y = "Proportion of genotyped \n mutations in immune loci") +
  facet_wrap(~ celltype_VDJ_recomb)
```

```{r, AnnotateMutsWithCellIDs}
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$cell_id <- NA 
for(x in 1:nrow(pta_additional_annotation_H1)){
  pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$cell_id[which(gsub("_dnahyb.*","",pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$id) == pta_additional_annotation_H1$well_ID[x])] <-  pta_additional_annotation_H1$cell_ID[x]
}

pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1 <- pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1[order(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$cell_id, decreasing = F),]
```

```{r, CreateHeatmapAnnotations}
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$mut_site <- paste(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$chr,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$pos,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$ref,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$alt,sep = "_")
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$merged_impact <- paste(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$gene,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$aachange,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$impact,sep = "_")

pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$heatmap_annot <- NA

for(x in 1:nrow(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1)){
  if(!(is.na(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$impact[x]))){
    if(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$impact[x] %in% c("Missense","Nonsense","Synonymous")){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$gene[x], pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$aachange[x], sep = "_")
    }else if(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$impact[x] =="Essential_Splice"){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$gene[x],"Splice",  sep = "_")
    }else if(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$type[x] == "del"){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste0(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$gene[x],"_Del_",nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$ref[x]) - 1,"bp")
    }else if(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$type[x] == "ins"){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste0(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$gene[x],"_Ins_",nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$alt[x]) - 1,"bp")
    }else{
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste0(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$gene[x],"_",pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$type[x])
    }
  }
}

heatmap_annot_vec <- unique(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$heatmap_annot)
for(x in 1:length(heatmap_annot_vec)){
  mut_site_vec <- unique(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$mut_site[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$heatmap_annot == heatmap_annot_vec[x])])
  if(length(mut_site_vec) > 1){
    for(y in 1:length(mut_site_vec)){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$heatmap_annot[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1$mut_site == mut_site_vec[y])] <- paste0(heatmap_annot_vec[x],"_#",y)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r, ObjectsUsedForEachGeneHeatmap}
csr.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","thistle"))
sv.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","firebrick"))
vj.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","springgreen4"))
cdr3.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("moccasin","navajowhite4"))
breakpoint.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","darkmagenta"))
antibody.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("red","white"))

multicell_clades <- unique(pta_additional_annotation_H1$clade_ID[duplicated(pta_additional_annotation_H1$clade_ID)])
multicell_clade_lims <- vector(length = 2*length(multicell_clades))

for(x in 1:length(multicell_clades)){
  multicell_clade_lims[x] <- -1 * (max(pta_additional_annotation_H1$cell_ID[pta_additional_annotation_H1$clade_ID == multicell_clades[x]]) + 0.5)
  multicell_clade_lims[x + length(multicell_clades)] <- -1 * (min(pta_additional_annotation_H1$cell_ID[pta_additional_annotation_H1$clade_ID == multicell_clades[x]]) - 0.5)
}

multicell_clade_lims <- sort(unique(multicell_clade_lims))


subclades <- unique(pta_additional_annotation_H1$subclade_ID)
subclades <- subclades[which(subclades != "")]
subclade_lims <- vector(length = length(subclades))

for(x in 1:length(subclade_lims)){
  subclade_lims[x] <- -1 * (max(pta_additional_annotation_H1$cell_ID[pta_additional_annotation_H1$subclade_ID == subclades[x]]) + 0.5)
}

subclade_lims <- subclade_lims[which(!(subclade_lims %in% multicell_clade_lims))]
```

```{r PTA_IgH_TCRA_Reformatting}
pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_V_consensus <- NA
pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_J_consensus <- NA
pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus <- NA
pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_J_consensus <- NA

for(x in 1:nrow(pta_additional_annotation_H1)){
  heavy_V_temp <- gsub("\\*.*","",unlist(strsplit(pta_additional_annotation_H1$productive_heavy_chain_V[x], split = ",")))
  heavy_V_temp <- gsub("IGHV","",heavy_V_temp)
  if(length(unique(heavy_V_temp)) == 1){
    pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_V_consensus[x] <- unique(heavy_V_temp)
  }else if(length(heavy_V_temp) > 2){
    pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_V_consensus[x] <- names(table(heavy_V_temp)[which(table(heavy_V_temp) == max(table(heavy_V_temp)))])
  }else if(length(unique(heavy_V_temp)) == 2){
    sb <- stri_sub(unique(heavy_V_temp)[2], 1, 1:nchar(unique(heavy_V_temp)[2]))
    sstr <- na.omit(stri_extract_all_coll(unique(heavy_V_temp)[1], sb, simplify=TRUE))
    if(length(sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]) > 0){
      pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_V_consensus[x] <- sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]
    }else{
      pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_V_consensus[x] <- ""
    }
  }
  
  
  heavy_J_temp <- gsub("\\*.*","",unlist(strsplit(pta_additional_annotation_H1$productive_heavy_chain_J[x], split = ",")))
  heavy_J_temp <- gsub("IGHJ","",heavy_J_temp)
  if(length(unique(heavy_J_temp)) == 1){
    pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_J_consensus[x] <- unique(heavy_J_temp)
  }else if(length(heavy_J_temp) > 2){
    pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_J_consensus[x] <- names(table(heavy_J_temp)[which(table(heavy_J_temp) == max(table(heavy_J_temp)))])
  }else if(length(unique(heavy_J_temp)) == 2){
    sb <- stri_sub(unique(heavy_J_temp)[2], 1, 1:nchar(unique(heavy_J_temp)[2]))
    sstr <- na.omit(stri_extract_all_coll(unique(heavy_J_temp)[1], sb, simplify=TRUE))
    if(length(sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]) > 0){
      pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_J_consensus[x] <- sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]
    }else{
      pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_J_consensus[x] <- ""
    }
  }
  
  TCRA_V_temp <- gsub("\\*.*","",unlist(strsplit(pta_additional_annotation_H1$productive_TCRA_chain_V[x], split = ",")))
  TCRA_V_temp <- gsub("TRAV","",TCRA_V_temp)
  if(length(unique(TCRA_V_temp)) == 1){
    pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus[x] <- unique(TCRA_V_temp)
  }else if(length(TCRA_V_temp) > 2){
    pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus[x] <- names(table(TCRA_V_temp)[which(table(TCRA_V_temp) == max(table(TCRA_V_temp)))])
  }else if(length(unique(TCRA_V_temp)) == 2){
    sb <- stri_sub(unique(TCRA_V_temp)[2], 1, 1:nchar(unique(TCRA_V_temp)[2]))
    sstr <- na.omit(stri_extract_all_coll(unique(TCRA_V_temp)[1], sb, simplify=TRUE))
    if(length(sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]) > 0){
      pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus[x] <- sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]
    }else{
      pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus[x] <- ""
    }
  }
  
  TCRA_J_temp <- gsub("\\*.*","",unlist(strsplit(pta_additional_annotation_H1$productive_TCRA_chain_J[x], split = ",")))
  TCRA_J_temp <- gsub("TRAJ","",TCRA_J_temp)
  if(length(unique(TCRA_J_temp)) == 1){
    pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_J_consensus[x] <- unique(TCRA_J_temp)
  }else if(length(TCRA_J_temp) > 2){
    pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_J_consensus[x] <- names(table(TCRA_J_temp)[which(table(TCRA_J_temp) == max(table(TCRA_J_temp)))])
  }else if(length(unique(TCRA_J_temp)) == 2){
    sb <- stri_sub(unique(TCRA_J_temp)[2], 1, 1:nchar(unique(TCRA_J_temp)[2]))
    sstr <- na.omit(stri_extract_all_coll(unique(TCRA_J_temp)[1], sb, simplify=TRUE))
    if(length(sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]) > 0){
      pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_J_consensus[x] <- sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]
    }else{
      pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_J_consensus[x] <- ""
    }
  }
}

pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus <- gsub("/DV.*","",pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus)

pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus[which(pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus %in% names(table(pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus)[which(table(pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_V_consensus) == 1)]))] <- "Unique"

pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_J_consensus[which(pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_J_consensus %in% names(table(pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_J_consensus)[which(table(pta_additional_annotation_H1$TCRA_J_consensus) == 1)]))] <- "Unique"

pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_V_consensus[which(pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_V_consensus %in% names(table(pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_V_consensus)[which(table(pta_additional_annotation_H1$heavy_V_consensus) == 1)]))] <- "Unique"
```

## 18. Mutational signature analysis and phylogenetic tree from de novo WGS calls for donor H1 PTA data 
```{r, H1DeNovoWGSMetadataSetup}
# set ggplot presets
theme_set(theme_classic())

celltype_cols <-
  c("non-naive B" = "#306b9b",
    "naive B" = "#449842",
    "alpha-beta T" = "#981c1e",
    "not B or T" = "#999999FF")

mut_lvls <-
  c("TNFRSF14 + CD274 mut", "TNFRSF14 mut", "CD274 mut",
    "TNFRSF14 WT + other mut")

cell_annots <- pta_additional_annotation_H1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = dplyr::case_when(
      celltype_SHM == "Mature B cell" ~ "non-naive B",
      celltype_VDJ_recomb == "B cell" ~ "naive B",
      celltype_VDJ_recomb == "alpha-beta T cell" ~ "alpha-beta T",
      TRUE ~ "not B or T"
    ) %>% factor(levels = names(celltype_cols)),
    mut = dplyr::case_when(
      cell_ID %in% 42:47 ~ "TNFRSF14 WT + other mut",
      !biallelic_TNFRSF14 %in% c("WT", "FALSE_Het") &
        !biallelic_CD274 %in% c("WT", "FALSE_Het") ~ "TNFRSF14 + CD274 mut",
      !biallelic_TNFRSF14 %in% c("WT", "FALSE_Het") ~ "TNFRSF14 mut",
      !biallelic_CD274 %in% c("WT", "FALSE_Het") ~ "CD274 mut",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = mut_lvls),
    celltype_col = celltype_cols[celltype]) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(celltype, mut) %>%
  tidyr::unite(celltype_mut, mut, celltype, sep = " ", na.rm = TRUE,
               remove = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype_mut = forcats::fct_inorder(celltype_mut)) %>%
  # create labels with newlines
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype_mut_label = dplyr::case_when(
      celltype_mut == "TNFRSF14 + CD274 mut non-naive B" ~ "TNFRSF14 +\nCD274 mut\nnon-naive B",
      celltype_mut == "TNFRSF14 mut non-naive B" ~ "TNFRSF14 mut\nnon-naive B",
      celltype_mut == "TNFRSF14 WT + other mut non-naive B" ~ "TNFRSF14 WT\n+ other mut\nnon-naive B",
      TRUE ~ as.character(celltype_mut)),
    celltype_mut_label = forcats::fct_inorder(celltype_mut_label))
```

### Plot phylogenetic tree with driver mutations in TNFRSF14 and CD274 annotated

```{r, Fig5C_H1DeNovoWGSTreeDriverMutsMainTwo, fig.width=10, fig.height=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load tree
tree <- ape::read.tree(pta_H1_de_novo_WGS_calls_phylogeny_file)

# create tree df
tree_df <- as.data.frame(ggtree::fortify(tree))

# get tip colours
tip_cols <-
  cell_annots %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(as.numeric(tree$tip.label), cell_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(celltype_col)

# get heatmap drivers
muts <- pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H1 %>%
  mutate(well_ID = gsub("_dna.*", "", id)) %>%
  inner_join(cell_annots %>% dplyr::select(well_ID, cell_ID), by = join_by(well_ID))

# function: plot drivers of interest on tree
plot_drivers_on_tree <- function(genes_of_interest) {

  # get heatmap drivers
  p_dat <-
    muts %>%
    filter(gene %in% genes_of_interest) %>%
    mutate(well_ID = gsub("_dna.*", "", id)) %>%
    inner_join(cell_annots %>% dplyr::select(well_ID, cell_ID)) %>%
    # reorder genes by number of mutations
    dplyr::add_count(gene) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = forcats::fct_reorder(gene, -n)) %>%
    # for klhl6 hotspot, separate 13/14 mutation from the 10 mutation
    dplyr::mutate(
      chr = dplyr::case_when(gene == "KLHL6" & cell_ID == 10 ~ "sep",
                            TRUE ~ chr))

  # get mrca edge of each shared mutations
  tips_ls <-
    p_dat %>%
    split(.$gene) %>%
    purrr::map(function(gene_df) {
      gene_df %>%
        group_by(chr, pos, ref, alt) %>%
        group_split() %>%
        purrr::map(~ as.character(.x$cell_ID))
    }) %>% purrr::map(unique)

  # get gene colours
  gene_cols <-
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(tips_ls), name = "Set3") %>%
    setNames(names(tips_ls))
  gene_cols[c("TNFRSF14", "CD274")] <- c("orange", "purple")

  # plot tree
  par(family = "sans")
  plot(tree, cex = 0.65, font = 1, tip.color = tip_cols, label.offset = 0.003 * max(tree_df$x))
  coords <- get("last_plot.phylo", envir = .PlotPhyloEnv)

  # start list of edges and track plotting
  edges <- list()
  edge_counts <- integer(0)  # track number of genes already plotted on each edge
  edge_gene_plotted <- character(0)  # track which (edge, gene) pairs already plotted

  purrr::walk2(names(tips_ls), tips_ls, function(gene, gene_tips) {

    edges[[gene]] <<- list()

    purrr::walk(gene_tips, function(tips) {

      # get edge before tip or mrca node
      if (length(tips) == 1) {
        mrca_node <- which(tree$tip.label == tips)
        edge <- which(tree$edge[, 2] == mrca_node)
      } else {
        mrca_node <- getMRCA(tree, tips)
        edge <- which(tree$edge[, 2] == mrca_node)

        # make sure edge descends to tips only
        desc_tips <- extract.clade(tree, mrca_node)$tip.label
        if (!all(desc_tips %in% tips)) {
          # if not, then get edge before each tip
          edge <-
            tips %>%
            purrr::map(function(tip) {
              which(tree$edge[, 2] == which(tree$tip.label == tip))
            }) %>%
            unlist()
        }
      }

      # add edge(s) to list of edges
      edges[[gene]] <<- c(edges[[gene]], list(edge))

      for (e in edge) {
        # skip if this (edge, gene) combination was already plotted
        edge_gene_key <- paste(e, gene, sep = "_")
        if (edge_gene_key %in% edge_gene_plotted) next
        edge_gene_plotted <<- c(edge_gene_plotted, edge_gene_key)
        
        # edge coordinates (parent -> child)
        x0 <- coords$xx[tree$edge[e, 1]]
        y0 <- coords$yy[tree$edge[e, 1]]
        x1 <- coords$xx[tree$edge[e, 2]]
        y1 <- coords$yy[tree$edge[e, 2]]
        
        # get the current count for this edge and increment
        edge_key <- as.character(e)
        if (is.na(edge_counts[edge_key])) {
          edge_counts[edge_key] <<- 0
        }
        current_count <- edge_counts[edge_key]
        edge_counts[edge_key] <<- current_count + 1
        
        # shift each successive gene further (alternating left/right from center)
        # count 0 -> shift 0 (centered), count 1 -> shift right, count 2 -> shift left, etc.
        base_shift <- 0.6 * strwidth("M", cex = 1)
        if (current_count == 0) {
          x_shift <- 0
        } else {
          # alternate: 1 -> +1, 2 -> -1, 3 -> +2, 4 -> -2, etc.
          direction <- ifelse(current_count %% 2 == 1, 1, -1)
          magnitude <- ceiling(current_count / 2)
          x_shift <- base_shift * magnitude * direction
        }
        
        x_mid <- (x0 + x1) / 2 + x_shift
        y_mid <- y1

        # add points
        points(x_mid, y_mid, pch = 19, col = gene_cols[gene], cex = 1)
      }

    })

  })

  # add axis and legend
  axisPhylo(side = 1, backward = FALSE)
  legend("bottomright",
        legend = c("Driver mutation", names(gene_cols), "Cell type",
                    names(celltype_cols)),
        text.font = c(2, rep(3, length(gene_cols)), 2,
                      rep(1, length(celltype_cols))),
        col = c(NA, gene_cols, rep("black", length(celltype_cols) + 1)),
        pch = c(NA, rep(19, length(gene_cols)), NA,
                rep(95, length(celltype_cols))),
        pt.cex = 1,
        cex = 0.7,
        bty = "n",
        text.col = c(rep("black", length(gene_cols) + 2), celltype_cols))
}

plot_drivers_on_tree(genes_of_interest = c("TNFRSF14", "CD274"))
```

```{r, LoadSignatureExposures, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
  c("black", RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(final_sigs), "Set2")) %>%
```

### Phylogenetic tree with signature exposures (tips coloured by celltype)

```{r EDF11A_PhylogeneticTreeWithSignatureExposures, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
# create tree
plot(tree, cex = 0.65, label.offset = 0.003 * max(tree_df$x),
     tip.color = celltype_cols, font = 1)

# for each sample, draw rectangles showing signature proportions
for (sample in colnames(sf_exp_w_indels)) {
  n <- as.numeric(substr(sample, 9, nchar(sample)))
  x_end <- tree_df$x[n]
  x_start <- tree_df$x[tree_df$parent[n]]
  x_intv <- x_end - x_start
  y <- node.height(tree)[n]
  tipnum <- sum(tree_df$isTip)

  # stack signature exposures proportionally along branch length
  for (s in rownames(sf_exp_w_indels)) {
    x_end <- x_start + sf_exp_w_indels[s, sample] * x_intv
    rect(ybottom = y - min(0.015 * tipnum, 0.3),
         ytop = y + min(0.015 * tipnum, 0.3),
         xleft = x_start, xright = x_end, col = sig_cols[s], lwd = 0.25)
    x_start <- x_end
  }
}

# axis and legend
axisPhylo(side = 1, backward = FALSE)
legend("topright",
       legend = c("Signature", names(sig_cols),
                  "Cell type", names(celltype_cols)),
       text.font = c(2, rep(1, length(sig_cols)), 2,
                     rep(1, length(celltype_cols))),
       col = c(NA, sig_cols, rep("black", length(celltype_cols) + 1)),
       pch = c(NA, rep(19, length(sig_cols)), NA,
                  rep(95, length(celltype_cols))),
       pt.cex = 1,
       cex = 0.7,
       bty = "n",
       text.col = c(rep("black", length(sig_cols) + 2), celltype_cols))
```

```{r LoadTrinucleotideMatrix}
    "T>A" = "grey70", "T>C" = "olivedrab3", "T>G" = "plum2")

# load trinuc mut matrix
trinuc_mut_mat <- read.table(pta_H1_de_novo_trinuc_mut_mat_hdp_file, check.names = FALSE)

# get all nodes leading to each tip for aggregating per cell
nodes_to_tips <-
  lapply(1:Ntip(tree), function(tip) {
    nodepath(tree, from = tip, to = Ntip(tree) + 1)
  }) %>%
  setNames(tree$tip.label) %>%
  tibble::enframe(name = "cell_ID", value = "node") %>%
  tidyr::unnest(cols = node)

# prepare plotting data
p_dat <-
  trinuc_mut_mat %>%
  tibble::as_tibble(rownames = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(node = as.numeric(gsub("Patient_", "", sample))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(nodes_to_tips, by = join_by(node)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(colnames(trinuc_mut_mat)), sum)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cell_annots %>% dplyr::mutate(cell_ID = as.character(cell_ID)), by = join_by(cell_ID))
```

### Signature exposures per cell

```{r EDF11C_SignatureExposuresPerCellBarcharts, fig.width = 17, fig.height = 8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load exposures with filled-in branches
per_branch_exp_final <- readRDS(pta_H1_de_novo_per_branch_exposures_file)

# get exposures per cell
exp_per_cell <-
  nodes_to_tips %>%
  dplyr::left_join(per_branch_exp_final, by = c("node")) %>%
  # calculate mutations per exposure
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(c("indels", final_sigs)),
                      names_to = "signature", values_to = "exposure") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_muts_exp = exposure * branch.length) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_ID, signature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_muts_exp = sum(n_muts_exp)) %>%
  # calculate mutations per cell
  dplyr::group_by(cell_ID) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total_n_muts = sum(n_muts_exp)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  # add cell annots
  dplyr::left_join(cell_annots %>% dplyr::mutate(cell_ID = as.character(cell_ID))) %>%
  # factor axes
  dplyr::mutate(cell_ID = forcats::fct_reorder(cell_ID, -total_n_muts),
                signature = factor(signature, levels = rev(c("indels", final_sigs)))) %>%
  # calculate proportions and numbers of mutations
  dplyr::mutate(`n mutations` = n_muts_exp,
                `% mutations` = n_muts_exp / total_n_muts) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("n mutations", "% mutations"),
                      names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("n mutations", "% mutations")))

# plot
exp_per_cell %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cell_ID, y = value, fill = signature)) +
  geom_col(width = 1.05) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_cols) +
  guides(x = guide_axis(angle = 90)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.6, "lines"),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7),
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(metric ~ celltype_mut_label, scales = "free", space = "free_x") +
  ggtitle("by celltype and TNFRSF14/CD274 status")
```

```{r Fig5E_DeNovoSBS9ByMutationStatus, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
exp_per_cell <- readRDS(pta_H1_de_novo_exposures_per_cell_file)  %>%
  split(.$signature)

one_cell_per_clade <- vector()
wgs_clades <- unique(pta_additional_annotation_H1$clade_ID[which(pta_additional_annotation_H1$wgs_sequencing == 1)])

pta_annotation_reordered <- rbind(pta_additional_annotation_H1[which(pta_additional_annotation_H1$reconstruction_confidence == "high"),],pta_additional_annotation_H1[which(pta_additional_annotation_H1$reconstruction_confidence == "low"),],pta_additional_annotation_H1[which(pta_additional_annotation_H1$reconstruction_confidence == ""),])

for(j in 1:length(wgs_clades)){
  one_cell_per_clade <- c(one_cell_per_clade,pta_annotation_reordered$cell_ID[which(pta_annotation_reordered$clade_ID == wgs_clades[j])][1])
}

exp_per_clade <- exp_per_cell
for(j in 1:length(exp_per_clade)){
  exp_per_clade[[j]] <- exp_per_clade[[j]][which(exp_per_clade[[j]]$tip_id %in% one_cell_per_clade & exp_per_clade[[j]]$metric == "n mutations"),]
}

p_dat_per_clade <- p_dat[which(p_dat$cell_ID %in% one_cell_per_clade),]

purrr::map2(names(exp_per_clade), exp_per_clade, function(sig, p_dat_per_clade) {
  p <-
    p_dat_per_clade %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = celltype_mut, y = n_muts_exp)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
    geom_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.2)
  my_comparisons <-
    p_dat_per_clade %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype_maturity == "mature B", celltype_mut != "mature B") %>%
    dplyr::pull(celltype_mut) %>%
    unique() %>%
    as.character() %>%
    purrr::map(~ c("mature B", .x))
  p +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons,
                               method = "wilcox.test",
                               label = "p.format",
                               method.args = list(alternative = "two.sided")) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = "Wilcoxon test", 
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 5, fontface = "italic") +
    ggtitle(sig) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())
  if (runman) {ggsave(paste0("./output/wilcoxon_",sig,".pdf"), width = 8, height = 10)}
})
```

## 20. Single nucleus DNA sequencing from donors H2 and H8

For each nucleus, we generated a PTA sequencing library. For the nuclei from donors H2 and H8, we only carried out targeted sequencing (i.e. no WGS) using the same panel of 725 genes used for targeted NanoSeq.
Mutations called by targeted NanoSeq were genotyped in the DNAHyb PTA data. The filtered mutations table shows those genotyped mutations with convincing support (i.e. VAF ≥ 0.25 & total depth ≥ 10).

```{r LoadAdditionalPTAData, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8 <- read.table(pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2 <- read.table(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H8 <- read.table(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H8_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8 <- rbind(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H8)

pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$type <- NA
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$type[which(nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$ref) == 1 & nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$alt) == 1)] <- "snv"
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$type[which(nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$ref) > nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$alt))] <- "del"
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$type[which(nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$ref) < nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$alt))] <- "ins"
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$type[which(nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$ref) == nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$alt) & nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$ref) != 1)] <- "mnv"
```

Rescued structural variants affecting CD274 in donor H8. It is often difficult to be certain that individual SVs are genuine in targeted sequencing data as unlikely to observe breakpoint. However, these are particularly compelling as they occur across multiple cells within a clade.

```{r IncorporateRescuedPTAmutsDonorH8, message=FALSE}
pta_dna_hyb_rescued_muts_H8 <- read_xlsx(pta_dna_hyb_rescued_muts_H8_file)
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8 <- rbind(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8, pta_dna_hyb_rescued_muts_H8)
```

```{r Additional_IdentifyMatureBcellsBySHMAdditionalPTA, fig.height=4, fig.width=7, warnings = FALSE}
pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$total_muts <- NA
pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$muts_in_immune_loci <- NA

for(x in 1:nrow(pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8)){
  temp_muts <- pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8[which(gsub("_dnahyb.*","",pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$id) == pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$well_ID[x]),]
  
  pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$total_muts[x] <- nrow(temp_muts)
  pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$muts_in_immune_loci[x] <- length(which(((temp_muts$chr == "14" & temp_muts$pos >= 106053226 & temp_muts$pos <= 107288019)|(temp_muts$chr == "22" & temp_muts$pos >= 22380474 & temp_muts$pos <= 23265203))))
}

pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$prop_immune_loci <- pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$muts_in_immune_loci / pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$total_muts
pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$prop_immune_loci[which(is.nan(pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$prop_immune_loci))] <- 0

pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$celltype_SHM <- NA
pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$celltype_SHM[pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$prop_immune_loci >= 0.1 & pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$muts_in_immune_loci >= 3] <- "Mature B cell"
pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$celltype_SHM[(pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$prop_immune_loci < 0.1 & pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$prop_immune_loci > 0) | (pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$muts_in_immune_loci < 3 & pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$muts_in_immune_loci > 0)] <- "Uncertain"
pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$celltype_SHM[pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$muts_in_immune_loci == 0] <- "Not mature B cell"

ggplot() +
```

```{r, CreateHeatmapAnnotationsAdditionalPTA}
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$mut_site <- paste(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$chr,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$pos,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$ref,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$alt,sep = "_")
pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$merged_impact <- paste(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$gene,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$aachange,pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$impact,sep = "_")

pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$heatmap_annot <- NA

for(x in 1:nrow(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8)){
  if(!(is.na(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$impact[x]))){
    if(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$impact[x] %in% c("Missense","Nonsense","Synonymous")){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$gene[x], pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$aachange[x], sep = "_")
    }else if(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$impact[x] =="Essential_Splice"){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$gene[x],"Splice",  sep = "_")
    }else if(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$type[x] == "del"){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste0(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$gene[x],"_Del_",nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$ref[x]) - 1,"bp")
    }else if(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$type[x] == "ins"){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste0(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$gene[x],"_Ins_",nchar(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$alt[x]) - 1,"bp")
    }else{
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$heatmap_annot[x] <- paste0(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$gene[x],"_",pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$type[x])
    }
  }
}

heatmap_annot_vec <- unique(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$heatmap_annot)
for(x in 1:length(heatmap_annot_vec)){
  mut_site_vec <- unique(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$mut_site[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$heatmap_annot == heatmap_annot_vec[x])])
  if(length(mut_site_vec) > 1){
    for(y in 1:length(mut_site_vec)){
      pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$heatmap_annot[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$mut_site == mut_site_vec[y])] <- paste0(heatmap_annot_vec[x],"_#",y)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r, EDF8_CreateHeatmapForEachAdditionalDonor, fig.height=20, fig.width=15}
donors <- c("H2","H8")

for(z in 1:length(donors)){
  pta_additional_annotation_single_donor <- pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8[which(substr(pta_additional_annotation_H2_H8$cell_ID,1,2) == donors[z]),]
  pta_dna_hyb_mutation_single_donor <- pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_H2_H8$paper_id == donors[z]),]
  
  pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$cell_ID <- as.numeric(gsub(paste0(donors[z],"_"),"",pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$cell_ID))
  
  empty_frame <- as.data.frame(array(data = NA, dim = c(length(unique(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$cell_ID)),1)))
  colnames(empty_frame) <- "cell_id"
  empty_frame$cell_id <- unique(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$cell_ID)
  
  color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white", "navy"))
  wgs.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","lightgoldenrod1"))
  vdj.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("lightcyan","lightcoral","palegreen1"))
  shm.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","peachpuff","lightyellow1"))
  hap.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","lightpink","lightblue"))
  csr.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","thistle"))
  sv.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","firebrick"))
  vj.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","springgreen4"))
  cdr3.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("moccasin","navajowhite4"))
  breakpoint.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","darkmagenta"))
  antibody.color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("red","white"))
  
  multicell_clades <- unique(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$clade_ID[duplicated(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$clade_ID)])
  multicell_clade_lims <- vector(length = 2*length(multicell_clades))
  
  if(length(multicell_clade_lims) > 0){
    for(x in 1:length(multicell_clades)){
      multicell_clade_lims[x] <- -1 * (max(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$cell_ID[pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$clade_ID == multicell_clades[x]]) + 0.5)
      multicell_clade_lims[x + length(multicell_clades)] <- -1 * (min(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$cell_ID[pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$clade_ID == multicell_clades[x]]) - 0.5)
    }
    multicell_clade_lims <- sort(unique(multicell_clade_lims))
  }
  
  pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$subclade_ID[is.na(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$subclade_ID)] <- ""
  
  subclades <- unique(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$subclade_ID)
  subclades <- subclades[which(subclades != "")]
  subclade_lims <- vector(length = length(subclades))
  
  if(length(subclade_lims) > 0){
    for(x in 1:length(subclade_lims)){
      subclade_lims[x] <- -1 * (max(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$cell_ID[pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$subclade_ID == subclades[x]]) + 0.5)
    }
    
    subclade_lims <- subclade_lims[which(!(subclade_lims %in% multicell_clade_lims))]
  }
  
  pta_cell_type <- reshape2::melt(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor[,c("cell_ID","celltype_VDJ_recomb","celltype_SHM","csr")], id.vars = "cell_ID")
  pta_cell_type$value[which(pta_cell_type$value %in% c("doublet","not lymphocyte","Uncertain"))] <- 0
  pta_cell_type$value[which(pta_cell_type$value %in% c("B cell","Mature B cell"))]  <- 1
  pta_cell_type$value[which(pta_cell_type$value %in% c("alpha-beta T cell","Not mature B cell"))]  <- 2
  
  pta_cell_type$value <- as.numeric(pta_cell_type$value)
  
  # Create SHM heatmap
  cell_type_SHM = levelplot(value~variable*-cell_ID, pta_cell_type[which(pta_cell_type$variable == "celltype_SHM"),], col.regions=shm.color.palette, scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, at = seq(from = -1, to = -1 * nrow(empty_frame), by = -1), labels = c(1:nrow(empty_frame))), x = list(alternating = 3, rot = 90)), ylab = NULL, xlab="", colorkey=FALSE, 
                            panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
                            panel.levelplot(...)
                            panel.abline(h = multicell_clade_lims)
                            panel.abline(h = subclade_lims, lty = 2)})
  
  # Create VDJ heatmap
  cell_type_VDJ = levelplot(value~variable*-cell_ID, pta_cell_type[which(pta_cell_type$variable == "celltype_VDJ_recomb"),], col.regions=vdj.color.palette, scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, at = seq(from = -1, to = -1 * nrow(empty_frame), by = -1), labels = c(1:nrow(empty_frame))), x = list(alternating = 3, rot = 90)), ylab = NULL, xlab="", colorkey=FALSE,
                            panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
                            panel.levelplot(...)
                            panel.abline(h = multicell_clade_lims)
                            panel.abline(h = subclade_lims, lty = 2)})
  
  # Create CSR heatmap
cell_type_csr = levelplot(value~variable*-cell_ID, pta_cell_type[which(pta_cell_type$variable == "csr"),], col.regions=csr.color.palette, scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, at = seq(from = -1, to = -1 * nrow(empty_frame), by = -1), labels = c(1:nrow(empty_frame))), x = list(alternating = 3, rot = 90)), ylab = NULL, xlab="", colorkey=FALSE,
                          panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
                          panel.levelplot(...)
                          panel.abline(h = multicell_clade_lims)
                          panel.abline(h = subclade_lims, lty = 2)})
  
  pta_TNFRSF14_muts <- pta_dna_hyb_mutation_single_donor[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_single_donor$gene == "TNFRSF14"),c("cell_id","heatmap_annot","alt_vaf")]
  pta_TNFRSF14_muts$heatmap_annot <- gsub("TNFRSF14_","",pta_TNFRSF14_muts$heatmap_annot)
  pta_TNFRSF14_mut_array <- reshape2::dcast(pta_TNFRSF14_muts, cell_id ~ heatmap_annot, value.var = "alt_vaf")
  pta_TNFRSF14_mut_array <- pta_TNFRSF14_mut_array[,c("cell_id",unique(pta_TNFRSF14_muts$heatmap_annot))]
  
  pta_TNFRSF14_mut_array <- left_join(empty_frame, pta_TNFRSF14_mut_array, by = "cell_id")
  pta_TNFRSF14_muts <- reshape2::melt(pta_TNFRSF14_mut_array, id.var = "cell_id")
  pta_TNFRSF14_muts$value[is.na(pta_TNFRSF14_muts$value)] <- 0 
  
  TNFRSF14_vaf_heatmap <- lattice::levelplot(value~variable*-cell_id, data = pta_TNFRSF14_muts, col.regions=color.palette(1000), scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, at = seq(from = -1, to = -1 * nrow(empty_frame), by = -1), labels = c(1:nrow(empty_frame))), x = list(alternating = 3, rot = 90)), ylab="Cell ID", xlab = "TNFRSF14", colorkey=list(space="top"), at = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = 0.001), main = list(label = "VAF"), panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
  panel.levelplot(...)
  panel.abline(h = multicell_clade_lims)
  panel.abline(h = subclade_lims, lty = 2)}, aspect = ncol(pta_TNFRSF14_mut_array))
  
  pta_CD274_muts <- pta_dna_hyb_mutation_single_donor[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_single_donor$gene == "CD274"),c("cell_id","heatmap_annot","alt_vaf")]
  
  if(nrow(pta_CD274_muts) > 0){
    pta_CD274_muts$heatmap_annot <- gsub("CD274_","",pta_CD274_muts$heatmap_annot)
    pta_CD274_mut_array <- reshape2::dcast(pta_CD274_muts, cell_id ~ heatmap_annot, value.var = "alt_vaf")
    pta_CD274_mut_array <- pta_CD274_mut_array[,c("cell_id",unique(pta_CD274_muts$heatmap_annot))]
    
    pta_CD274_mut_array <- left_join(empty_frame, pta_CD274_mut_array, by = "cell_id")
    pta_CD274_muts <- reshape2::melt(pta_CD274_mut_array, id.var = "cell_id")
    pta_CD274_muts$value[is.na(pta_CD274_muts$value)] <- 0 
    
    CD274_vaf_heatmap <- lattice::levelplot(value~variable*-cell_id, data = pta_CD274_muts, col.regions=color.palette(1000), scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, at = seq(from = -1, to = -1 * nrow(empty_frame), by = -1), labels = c(1:nrow(empty_frame))), x = list(alternating = 3, rot = 90)), ylab="Cell ID", xlab = "CD274", colorkey=list(space="top"), at = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = 0.001), main = list(label = "VAF"), panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
    panel.levelplot(...)
    panel.abline(h = multicell_clade_lims)
    panel.abline(h = subclade_lims, lty = 2)})
  }
  
  pta_other_gene_muts <- pta_dna_hyb_mutation_single_donor[which(pta_dna_hyb_mutation_single_donor$gene %in% c("DNMT3A","TET2","RASA2") & pta_dna_hyb_mutation_single_donor$impact != "Synonymous"),c("cell_id","heatmap_annot","alt_vaf")]
  
  if(nrow(pta_other_gene_muts) > 0){
    pta_other_gene_mut_array <- reshape2::dcast(pta_other_gene_muts, cell_id ~ heatmap_annot, value.var = "alt_vaf")
    pta_other_gene_mut_array <- pta_other_gene_mut_array[,c("cell_id",unique(pta_other_gene_muts$heatmap_annot))]
    
    pta_other_gene_mut_array <- pta_other_gene_mut_array[,c(1,
                                                            which(grepl("DNMT3A",colnames(pta_other_gene_mut_array))),
                                                            which(grepl("TET2",colnames(pta_other_gene_mut_array))),
                                                            which(grepl("RASA2",colnames(pta_other_gene_mut_array))))]
    
    pta_other_gene_mut_array <- left_join(empty_frame, pta_other_gene_mut_array, by = "cell_id")
    pta_other_gene_muts <- reshape2::melt(pta_other_gene_mut_array, id.var = "cell_id")
    pta_other_gene_muts$value[is.na(pta_other_gene_muts$value)] <- 0 
    
    other_gene_heatmap <- lattice::levelplot(value~variable*-cell_id, data = pta_other_gene_muts, col.regions=color.palette(1000), scales = list(tck = c(0,0), y = list(cex=1, at = seq(from = -1, to = -1 * nrow(empty_frame), by = -1), labels = c(1:nrow(empty_frame))), x = list(alternating = 3, rot = 90)), ylab="Cell ID", xlab = "Selected genes", colorkey=list(space="top", at = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = 0.001), title = "VAF"), main = list(label = "VAF"), panel=function(...) { arg <- list(...)
    panel.levelplot(...)
    panel.abline(h = multicell_clade_lims)
    panel.abline(h = subclade_lims, lty = 2)})
  }
  
  pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_V_consensus <- NA
  pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_J_consensus <- NA
  pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$TCRA_V_consensus <- NA
  pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$TCRA_J_consensus <- NA
  
  for(x in 1:nrow(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor)){
    heavy_V_temp <- gsub("\\*.*","",unlist(strsplit(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$productive_heavy_chain_V[x], split = ",")))
    heavy_V_temp <- gsub("IGHV","",heavy_V_temp)
    if(length(unique(heavy_V_temp)) == 1){
      pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_V_consensus[x] <- unique(heavy_V_temp)
    }else if(length(heavy_V_temp) > 2){
      pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_V_consensus[x] <- names(table(heavy_V_temp)[which(table(heavy_V_temp) == max(table(heavy_V_temp)))])
    }else if(length(unique(heavy_V_temp)) == 2){
      sb <- stri_sub(unique(heavy_V_temp)[2], 1, 1:nchar(unique(heavy_V_temp)[2]))
      sstr <- na.omit(stri_extract_all_coll(unique(heavy_V_temp)[1], sb, simplify=TRUE))
      if(length(sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]) > 0){
        pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_V_consensus[x] <- sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]
      }else{
        pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_V_consensus[x] <- ""
      }
    }
    
    
    heavy_J_temp <- gsub("\\*.*","",unlist(strsplit(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$productive_heavy_chain_J[x], split = ",")))
    heavy_J_temp <- gsub("IGHJ","",heavy_J_temp)
    if(length(unique(heavy_J_temp)) == 1){
      pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_J_consensus[x] <- unique(heavy_J_temp)
    }else if(length(heavy_J_temp) > 2){
      pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_J_consensus[x] <- names(table(heavy_J_temp)[which(table(heavy_J_temp) == max(table(heavy_J_temp)))])
    }else if(length(unique(heavy_J_temp)) == 2){
      sb <- stri_sub(unique(heavy_J_temp)[2], 1, 1:nchar(unique(heavy_J_temp)[2]))
      sstr <- na.omit(stri_extract_all_coll(unique(heavy_J_temp)[1], sb, simplify=TRUE))
      if(length(sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]) > 0){
        pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_J_consensus[x] <- sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]
      }else{
        pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$heavy_J_consensus[x] <- ""
      }
    }
    
    TCRA_V_temp <- gsub("\\*.*","",unlist(strsplit(pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$productive_TCRA_chain_V[x], split = ",")))
    TCRA_V_temp <- gsub("TRAV","",TCRA_V_temp)
    if(length(unique(TCRA_V_temp)) == 1){
      pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$TCRA_V_consensus[x] <- unique(TCRA_V_temp)
    }else if(length(TCRA_V_temp) > 2){
      pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$TCRA_V_consensus[x] <- names(table(TCRA_V_temp)[which(table(TCRA_V_temp) == max(table(TCRA_V_temp)))])
    }else if(length(unique(TCRA_V_temp)) == 2){
      sb <- stri_sub(unique(TCRA_V_temp)[2], 1, 1:nchar(unique(TCRA_V_temp)[2]))
      sstr <- na.omit(stri_extract_all_coll(unique(TCRA_V_temp)[1], sb, simplify=TRUE))
      if(length(sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]) > 0){
        pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$TCRA_V_consensus[x] <- sstr[which.max(nchar(sstr))]
      }else{
        pta_additional_annotation_single_donor$TCRA_V_consensus[x] <- ""
      }
    }
```
